-- Row-definition tables for the Properties panel's type sections. A constructor, so each
-- buildProperties() call gets fresh tables (built through W.buildTypeSection).
-- Sections show in PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK order: Emission > Appearance (Blender under it) >
-- Spawn > Motion > the rest in array order > Events > Advanced. A toggle_group's children come
-- after the section's other rows.

local reactorRows = require(script.Parent.BuildPropertiesReactorRows)

return function()
	local partDefs = {
		{name = "Emission", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop", label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled", label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="EmitMode", label="Type", type="dropdown", options={"Auto","Burst"}, default="Auto"},
			{key="Rate", label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime", label="Lifetime", type="input", default="1, 1", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Linger", label="Linger", type="input", default="0", placeholder="seconds"},
			{key="Timescale", label="Timescale", type="graph"},
		}},
		{name = "Spawn", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Orientation", label="Orientation", type="dropdown", options={"None","FacingCamera","FacingCameraWorldUp","VelocityParallel","VelocityPerpendicular"}, default="None"},
			{key="PosMode", label="Pos. Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Local","Global","RigidLocal"}, default="Local"},
			{key="Pos", label="Position", type="axis_input", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, placeholder="min, max", config={kind="axis-link", axes={"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, evenAttrs={X="PosXEven", Y="PosYEven", Z="PosZEven"}}},
			{key="PositionEvenCycle", label="Pos. Cycle", type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="RotOrder", label="Rot Order", type="dropdown", options={"Global","LocalXYZ","LocalXZY","LocalYXZ","LocalYZX","LocalZXY","LocalZYX"}, default="Global"},
			{key="Rot", label="Rotation", type="axis_input", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, placeholder="min, max", config={kind="axis-link", axes={"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, evenAttrs={X="RotXEven", Y="RotYEven", Z="RotZEven"}}},
			{key="RotationEvenCycle", label="Rot. Cycle", type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="UseShape", label="Use shape", type="toggle_group", children={
				{key="Shape",            label="Shape",            type="dropdown", options={"Box","Sphere","Cylinder","Disc"}, default="Box"},
				{key="ShapeInOut",       label="Direction",        type="dropdown", options={"Outward","Inward","InAndOut"}, default="Outward"},
				{key="ShapePartial",     label="Hollow",           type="input",    default="0", placeholder="0=solid, 1=hollow"},
				{key="LookAtInitially",  label="Look at initially", type="toggle"},
				{key="ShapePart",        label="Shape Part",        type="path",    config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="ShapePart", validate="BasePart"}},
			}},
		}},
		{name = "Motion", rows = {
			{key="Direction", label="Direction", type="dropdown", options={"Top","Bottom","Front","Back","Left","Right"}, default="Top"},
			{key="SpreadAngle", label="SpreadAngle", type="input", default="0, 0", placeholder="x, y"},
			{key="DirMode", label="Dir. Mode", type="dropdown", options={"RigidLocal","Local","Global"}, default="RigidLocal"},
			{key="Speed", label="Speed", type="graph"},
			{key="Acceleration", label="Acceleration", type="input", default="0, 0, 0", placeholder="x, y, z"},
			{key="Drag", label="Drag", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="InvertMotion", label="Reverse Motion", type="toggle"},
			{key="DisplacementMode", label="Displacement Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Global","Local","RigidLocal","Rotating"}, default="Global"},
			{key="PosOffset", label="Displacement", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"}}},
			{key="Turbulence", label="Turbulence", type="graph"},
			{key="TurbulenceFrequency", label="Turb. Frequency", type="input", default="1"},
			{key="RotMode", label="Rotation Mode", type="dropdown", options={"OverLife","Speed"}, default="OverLife"},
			{key="RotSpeed", label="Rotation Speed", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"}}},
			{key="AccelerationTowardsInstance", label="Accel toward", type="toggle_group", children={
				{key="AccelTarget", label="Target", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="AccelTarget"}},
				{key="AccelStrength", label="Strength", type="graph"},
			}},
		}},
		{name = "Appearance", rows = {
			{key="Material", label="Material", type="dropdown", options={"Plastic","SmoothPlastic","Neon","Glass","Metal","DiamondPlate","Foil","Brick","Concrete","Granite","Marble","Slate","Wood","WoodPlanks","Fabric","Ice","Sand","Grass","Pebble","Rock"}, default="Plastic"},
			{key="Color", label="Color", type="color"},
			{key="Brightness", label="Brightness", type="graph"},
			{key="Transparency", label="Transparency", type="graph"},
			{key="Size", label="Size", type="axis_graph_select", axes={"X","Y","Z"}, config={kind="axis-link", axes={"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}}},
			{key="ZOffset", label="Z-Offset", type="input", default="0"},
		}},
		{name = "Flipbook", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="FlipMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"None","OneShot","Loop","PingPong"}, default="OneShot"},
			{key="FlipFramerate", label="Framerate", type="input", default="30, 30", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="FlipStartRandom", label="StartRandom", type="toggle"},
			{key="FlipReverse", label="Reverse", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Mesh Frames", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="MeshFrameMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"None","OneShot","Loop","PingPong"}, default="OneShot"},
			{key="MeshFrameFramerate", label="Framerate", type="input", default="24, 24", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="MeshFrameStartRandom", label="Start Random", type="toggle"},
			{key="MeshFrameReverse", label="Reverse", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Link", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Link", label="Link Dir.", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="Link", setAttributes={LinkSource="Object"}, clearAttributes={LinkSource="None"}}},
			{key="LinkSource", label="Link", type="dropdown", options={"None","Camera","Object"}, default="None"},
			{key="LinkMode", label="Link Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Weld","Follow","Pivot","WeldWithoutRotation","RigidLocal"}, default="Follow"},
			{key="LinkAxes", label="Link Axes", type="link_axes", groups={{prefix="Pos", attrs={X="LinkPosX", Y="LinkPosY", Z="LinkPosZ"}}, {prefix="Rot", attrs={X="LinkRotX", Y="LinkRotY", Z="LinkRotZ"}}}},
		}},
		-- A mesh part-icle that becomes a Reactor: the switch and the Reactor's own rows.
		reactorRows.forPartIcle(),
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Keyframes", label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
			{key="EmitParent", label="Emit Into", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="EmitParent", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
			{key="PreloadTexture", label="Preload Texture", type="toggle"},
			{key="Pool", label="Pool", type="toggle"},
		}},
	}

	local beamDefs = {

			{key="FlipFramerate", label="Framerate", type="input", default="30, 30", placeholder="min, max"},

		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {

	local teDefs = {

-- BuildPropertiesForce  -  Properties panel section for Force, built by BuildProperties.

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local buildDefs = require(script.Parent.BuildPropertiesDefs)
local BuildPropertiesForce = {}

-- Spawn, Motion and Link are the mesh's own rows (BuildPropertiesDefs.partDefs), so a row added
-- there reaches the Force. LEFT_OUT rows belong to something drawn; RENAMED keys would collide with
-- the Force's own Direction and Turbulence. PropertyInputsForce and PopulateForce read these keys.
local MESH_SECTIONS = { "Spawn", "Motion", "Link" }
local LEFT_OUT = { Orientation = true, ZOffset = true, UseShape = true }
local RENAMED = { Direction = "MoveDirection", Turbulence = "MotionTurbulence" }

-- A mesh section's rows as a Force section, folded until it is wanted.
local function meshSection(partDefs, name)
	for _, section in ipairs(partDefs) do
		if section.name == name then
			local rows = {}
			for _, row in ipairs(section.rows) do
				if not LEFT_OUT[row.key] then
					row.key = RENAMED[row.key] or row.key
					table.insert(rows, row)
				end
			end
			return { name = name, collapsed = true, rows = rows }
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--[[
	BuildPropertiesReactorRows  -  the Reactor's row definitions, for the two sections that show them.
	  sections()     the groups of the Reactors type section (BuildPropertiesReactor)
	  forPartIcle()  a mesh part-icle's Reactor group: the Reacts toggle and the rows an emitted copy uses
	Fresh tables at every call. Row keys are TypeDataReactor's property names; a part-icle's keys are
	TypeDataReactor.PARTICLE_KEYS. Wired by PropertyInputsReactor, filled by PopulateReactor.
]]

local Rows = {}

-- Not for an emitted copy: its pieces are all let go, so nothing collapses; Scatter fills a standing
-- Reactor; "Cracks" is cracked ground. A mesh's Hit Filter is its Events row, which its pieces read.
local NOT_FOR_PARTICLE = { Collapse = true, HitFilter = true }
local NOT_FOR_PARTICLE_SECTION = "Scatter"
local NOT_FOR_PARTICLE_PATTERN = "Cracks"

-- Options: After, Break, Pattern and Shape are TypeDataReactor.AFTER, BREAK, SHARD_PATTERNS and
-- SCATTER_SHAPES. PopulateReactor hides the time rows while After is Stay and shows Pieces for Blocks
-- and Shards, Pattern for Shards, Hollow for a Circle. Scatter's pickers write ObjectValues on the
-- Reactor; PropertyInputsReactor wires its buttons. Resistance rows show the config's Hold and HoldSpread.
function Rows.sections()
	return {
		{name = "Response", rows = {
			{key="Hold",       label="Resistance", type="input", default="0"},
			{key="HoldSpread", label="Resistance Randomness", classicLabel="Resist. Random", type="input", default="0.3"},
			{key="Group",      label="Group", type="input", default="", placeholder="none"},
			{key="MaxPieces",  label="Max Pieces", type="input", default="800"},
		}},
		{name = "Break", rows = {
			{key="Break",        label="Break", type="dropdown", options={"None","Blocks","Shards"}, default="None"},
			{key="Pieces",       label="Pieces", type="input", default="50", placeholder="per part"},
			{key="ShardPattern", label="Pattern", type="dropdown", options={"Even","Around hit","Cracks"}, default="Even"},
			{key="Collapse",     label="Collapse", type="toggle"},
		}},
		{name = "Motion", rows = {
			{key="Gravity",     label="Gravity", type="input", default="196.2, 196.2", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Bounciness",  label="Bounciness", type="input", default="0.3, 0.5", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Friction",    label="Friction", type="input", default="0.5, 0.7", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="TumbleSpeed", label="Tumble Speed", type="input", default="90, 360", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="MaxAirTime",  label="Max Air Time", type="input", default="15", placeholder="seconds"},
		}},
		{name = "After", rows = {
			{key="After",      label="After", type="dropdown", options={"Stay","Fade","Return"}, default="Stay"},
			{key="AfterDelay", label="Delay", type="input", default="2"},
			{key="AfterTime",  label="Time", type="input", default="1.5"},
		}},
		{name = "Scatter", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="ScatterSource",  label="Pieces", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="ScatterSource", acceptAnyInstance=true}},
			{key="ScatterRegion",  label="Region", type="path", config={kind="instance-picker", objectValue="ScatterRegion", validate="BasePart"}},
			{key="ScatterShape",   label="Shape", type="dropdown", options={"Box","Circle","Region shape"}, default="Box"},
			{key="ScatterHollow",  label="Hollow", type="input", default="0", placeholder="0 to 0.95"},
			{key="ScatterCount",   label="Count", type="input", default="40"},
			{key="ScatterSpacing", label="Spacing", type="input", default="1"},
			{key="ScatterTurn",    label="Turn", type="dropdown", options={"Upright","Any way"}, default="Upright"},
			{key="ScatterSize",    label="Size", type="input", default="0.8, 1.2", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="ScatterSeed",    label="Seed", type="input", default="1"},
			{key="ScatterActions", label="Place", type="buttons", buttons={{key="Fill", text="Fill"}, {key="Clear", text="Clear"}}},
		}},
		-- What the pieces' rays meet: the Hit Filter Rocks and OnHit use.
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="HitFilter", label="Hit Filter", type="hit_filter"},
		}},
	}
end

-- One folded group, "Reactor": the switch, then the rows above in order, shown while it is on.
-- GetDataRig.readReacting reads the config's Reacts.
function Rows.forPartIcle()
	local rows = {}
	for _, section in ipairs(Rows.sections()) do
		if section.name ~= NOT_FOR_PARTICLE_SECTION then
			for _, row in ipairs(section.rows) do
				if not NOT_FOR_PARTICLE[row.key] then
					local cracks = row.options and table.find(row.options, NOT_FOR_PARTICLE_PATTERN)
					if row.key == "ShardPattern" and cracks then
						table.remove(row.options, cracks)
					end
					table.insert(rows, row)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return { name = "Reactor", collapsed = true, rows = {
		{ key = "Reacts", label = "React to Forces", type = "toggle_group", children = rows },
	} }
end

return Rows

local function buildModern(screenGui)
	local labelWidth = PanelSizes.of("SettingsLabel")
	local refs = {}

	local panel = W.makePanel(screenGui, "SettingsPanel", PanelSizes.of("Settings"))
	-- Bottom-right, so the panel sits just above the toggle bar whatever its height.
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	W.lay(panel, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -(PanelSizes.bottomBarTop() + 4))
	end)
	panel.Visible = false

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Settings", 0)
	refs.SettingsClose = bar.close
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)

	local delayBox, delayRow = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "AutoEmitDelay", "AutoEmit Delay", "1", labelWidth, 1)
	refs.AutoEmitDelayBox = delayBox
	-- After / Every takes the left end of the field's room.
	local delayField = delayBox.Parent
	local function fieldLeft()
		return labelWidth() + LAYOUT.LabelGap
	end
	refs.AutoEmitModeButton = W.makeActionButton(delayRow, "AutoEmitMode", "After", 0)
	W.layProps(refs.AutoEmitModeButton, function()
		return { Size = UDim2.new(0, MODE_BUTTON_WIDTH, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, fieldLeft(), 0, 0) }
	end)
	W.layProps(delayField, function()
		local left = fieldLeft() + MODE_BUTTON_WIDTH + 4
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 1, 0) }
	end)
	refs.UIScaleBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "UIScale", "UI Scale %", tostring(C.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT), labelWidth, 2)
	-- The engine skips new emits past this many live particles.
	refs.ParticleCapBox = W.makeNumberRow(panel, "ParticleCap", "Particle Cap", "1000", labelWidth, 3)

	W.makeDivider(panel, 4)

	-- Each is saved with plugin:SetSetting under its name and defaults to on (SettingsToggles).
	refs.EdgeSnapToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "EdgeSnap", "Snap Panels In View", 6)
	refs.ConsoleOutputToggle = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "ConsoleOutput", "Console Output", 7)
	-- Shortcuts/Runtime rewrites the label with the keys as they are bound.
	local workspacesToggle, _, workspacesLabel = W.makeSwitchRow(panel, "Workspaces", "Workspaces ( /  =  - )", 8)
	workspacesLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.WorkspacesToggle = workspacesToggle
	refs.WorkspacesLabel = workspacesLabel

	W.makeDivider(panel, 9)

	refs.EditThemeButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "EditTheme", "Edit Theme", 10)
	refs.ShortcutsButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "Shortcuts", "Shortcuts", 11)
	refs.ResetLayoutButton = W.makeActionButton(panel, "ResetLayout", "Reset Layout", 12)

	refs.SettingsPanel = panel
	return refs
end

return function(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(screenGui)
	end
	return buildModern(screenGui)
end

--[[

	see-through, title font, background image, preset, theme code and Apply / Cancel / Reset. Other
	modes build UIBuilder/ThemeEditor (wired by ThemeWiring).
	Returns build(screenGui) -> refs. Classic's, read by name in ThemeWiringClassic:
	  ThemeEditor, ModeDropdown, ModeOnChanged, AccentColor, BgColor, BlobColor, SliderColor,
	  ScrollBarColor, TextColor (each { hex, swatch }), BgImageBox, BgImageOpacityBox, FontDropdown,

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)

local function buildClassic(screenGui)

	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-120,0.5,-200); panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,240,0,0)

	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)

	local refs = {}

	local header = W.makeBlob("Header", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,24)); header.LayoutOrder = -3
	local ht = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ht.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ht.Text = "Theme Editor"
	ht.TextColor3 = T.Gold; ht.Font = T.Font; ht.TextSize = 12; ht.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	ht.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0); ht.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,0); ht.Parent = header
	local dh = Instance.new("TextButton"); dh.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dh.Text = ""
	dh.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0); dh.ZIndex = 2; dh.Parent = header; W.makeDraggable(panel, dh)

	local function makeThemeColorRow(label, lo, defaultColor)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.Name = label:gsub("%s+","").."Row"; row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel
		local rl = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0,70,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", rl, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 9)
		local swatchBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); swatchBtn.Name = "Swatch"; swatchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultColor; swatchBtn.Text = ""
		swatchBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,20,0,20); swatchBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,74,0,2); swatchBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; swatchBtn.AutoButtonColor = false; swatchBtn.Parent = row
		W.addCorner(swatchBtn, UDim.new(0,4)); W.addStroke(swatchBtn)
		local hw = W.makeBlob("HW", row, UDim2.new(1,-100,1,0)); hw.Position = UDim2.new(0,100,0,0)
		local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Hex"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = C.color3ToHex(defaultColor)
		tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 10; tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false; tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = hw
		return {hex = tb, swatch = swatchBtn}
	end
	refs.AccentColor = makeThemeColorRow("Accent", 1, T.InputAccent); refs.BgColor = makeThemeColorRow("Background", 2, T.InputBg)
	refs.BlobColor = makeThemeColorRow("Field", 3, T.InputBlob); refs.SliderColor = makeThemeColorRow("Slider", 4, T.InputSlider)
	refs.ScrollBarColor = makeThemeColorRow("Scroll Bar", 5, T.InputScrollBar); refs.TextColor = makeThemeColorRow("Text", 6, T.TextAccent)

	-- Percent see-through: 0 is opaque, 100 clear, 1:1 with BackgroundTransparency / ImageTransparency.
	local function makeOpacityRow(label, lo, defaultAlpha)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame"); row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,24); row.LayoutOrder = lo; row.Parent = panel
		local rl = W.makeBlob("L", row, UDim2.new(0,100,1,0)); W.makeLabel("L", rl, label, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 8)
		local rw = W.makeBlob("W", row, UDim2.new(1,-104,1,0)); rw.Position = UDim2.new(0,104,0,0)

--[[
	CodeScroll  -  a box of code that scrolls: the Emit Code panel's, in ToolPanels and ToolLayouts/Panels.
	CodeScroll.hold(wrap, box, pad, thickness) -> list: fills `wrap` with a list that scrolls down only,
	  holding the wrapping TextBox `box` as wide as the list and as tall as its text, `pad` from every
	  edge (pixels, or a LAYOUT key). A change of text scrolls back to the top.
	A wrapped text's automatic height stops at its parent's room and a list gives only its window, so
	the box grows in a holder taller than any snippet and the canvas follows the box's height.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local T = C.T

local HOLDER_HEIGHT = 200000

local CodeScroll = {}

function CodeScroll.hold(wrap, box, pad, thickness)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "CodeScroll"
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = thickness
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scroll.Parent = wrap
	W.addPadding(scroll, pad, pad, pad, pad)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)

	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Holder"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HOLDER_HEIGHT)
	holder.Parent = scroll

	box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	box.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	box.Parent = holder

	-- AbsoluteSize is in screen pixels and the canvas in the list's own: the holder's height,
	-- known in both, is the factor between them.
	box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
		local holderHeight = holder.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if holderHeight <= 0 then
			return
		end
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, box.AbsoluteSize.Y * HOLDER_HEIGHT / holderHeight + W.measure(pad) * 2)
	end)
	-- Other code is read from its first line.
	box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end)
	return scroll
end

return CodeScroll

		local setBtn, clearBtn, cancelBtn
		if opts.allowClear then
			local function makeBtn3(text, col, x)
				local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
				b.BackgroundColor3 = col; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
				b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 0, 22)
				b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
				W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
				return b
			end
			setBtn = makeBtn3("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			clearBtn = makeBtn3("Clear", T.BlobBg, 1/3)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn3("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 2/3)
		else
			setBtn = makeBtn("Set", T.BlobBg, 0)
			cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", T.BlobBg, 0.5)
		end

		local _selected = nil
		-- The last pick seen. Clicking Set can move focus to the plugin GUI, and Studio then reports an
		-- empty Selection mid-click.
		local _selectedCache = nil
		-- The items the picker was opened for cannot be their own target.
		local excludeSet = {}
		if opts.excludeItems then
			for _, ex in ipairs(opts.excludeItems) do excludeSet[ex] = true end
		end
		local function refreshFromSelection()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			_selected = picked
			if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			instanceLine.Text = _selected and ("Instance: " .. _selected:GetFullName())
				or (_selectedCache and ("Instance: " .. _selectedCache:GetFullName() .. " (cached)"))
				or "Instance: <nil>"
		end
		refreshFromSelection()
		-- In Connections too, so teardown disconnects it if the panel never closes.
		local conn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(refreshFromSelection)
		if deps.Connections then deps.Connections["ConfigPanelInstancePicker"] = conn end

		-- A 0.2 s poll catches picks that never fire SelectionChanged (deferred signals can drop them
		-- under load). Ends when the panel closes.
		local _alive = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while _alive do
				task.wait(0.2)
				if not _alive then return end
				local sel = Selection:Get()
				local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
				if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
				if picked then _selectedCache = picked end
			end
		end)

		local function close(commit)
			_alive = false
			if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			-- Live Selection first, else the cached pick.
			local commitTarget = _selected or _selectedCache
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(commitTarget) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end

		-- On mouse down, before Studio's focus shift empties Selection (it reads empty by Activated);
		-- anywhere on the panel, not just Set.
		local function snapshotSelectionNow()
			local sel = Selection:Get()
			local picked = sel and sel[1] or nil
			if picked and excludeSet[picked] then picked = nil end
			if picked then
				_selectedCache = picked
				_selected = picked
				instanceLine.Text = "Instance: " .. picked:GetFullName()
			end
		end
		setBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(snapshotSelectionNow)
		panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then snapshotSelectionNow() end
		end)

		-- opts.validate runs before closing: a rejected pick keeps the panel open and flashes a hint.
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Read Selection again: with deferred signals Set can fire before the SelectionChanged listener.
			refreshFromSelection()
			local target = _selected or _selectedCache
			if not target then
				instanceLine.Text = "No instance selected  -  click one in Studio first"
				instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
				return
			end
			if opts.validate then
				local okValid, msg = opts.validate(target)
				if not okValid then
					instanceLine.Text = msg or "Invalid selection  -  pick a different instance"
					instanceLine.TextColor3 = T.Red or Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
					return
				end
			end
			_selected = target
			close(true)
		end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		if clearBtn then
			clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
				panel:Destroy()
				if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
				if opts.onClear then opts.onClear() end
			end)
		end

		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- opts.axes: full keys ({"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"}). opts.current and the linkMap given to onSet:
	-- { [axisKey] = primaryKey or nil }.
	local function openAxisLinkPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui"); return end
		local axes = opts.axes or {}
		if #axes == 0 then return end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_AxisLink"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 158)
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0; panel.ZIndex = 200; panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true); panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel); W.addStroke(panel); W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = opts.title or "Link axes"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 12; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201; title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		if opts.context and opts.context ~= "" then
			local ctxLine = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ctxLine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			ctxLine.Text = "for: " .. opts.context; ctxLine.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ctxLine.Font = T.Font; ctxLine.TextSize = 10; ctxLine.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			ctxLine.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; ctxLine.ZIndex = 201
			ctxLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); ctxLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			ctxLine.Parent = panel
		end

		local axisSet = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do axisSet[a] = true end
		-- Drops self-links and links outside this row's axes, so bad stored values do not round-trip.
		local linkMap = {}
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			local v = opts.current and opts.current[a] or nil
			if v == a or (v ~= nil and not axisSet[v]) then v = nil end
			linkMap[a] = v
		end
		local primary
		for _, a in ipairs(axes) do
			if linkMap[a] == nil then
				local hasFollower = false
				for _, b in ipairs(axes) do if b ~= a and linkMap[b] == a then hasFollower = true; break end end
				if hasFollower then primary = a; break end
			end
		end
		if not primary then primary = axes[1] end
		if linkMap[primary] then linkMap[primary] = nil end

		local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel"); prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		prompt.Text = "Primary axis (others can link to it):"; prompt.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		prompt.Font = T.Font; prompt.TextSize = 10; prompt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		prompt.ZIndex = 201; prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14); prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 38)
		prompt.Parent = panel

		local pillW = math.floor((280 - 16 - (#axes - 1) * 4) / #axes)
		local pills = {}
		-- Button -> axisKey: an Instance takes no custom fields.
		local pillAxes = {}
		-- onSet writes only the axes touched, so a mixed selection keeps the rest.
		local dirtyAxes = {}
		local function refreshPills()
			for _, p in ipairs(pills) do
				local axisKey = pillAxes[p]
				if axisKey == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					p.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg; p.Text = axisKey .. " *"
				elseif linkMap[axisKey] == primary then
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; p.Text = axisKey .. " ->"
				else
					p.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; p.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					p.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; p.Text = axisKey
				end
			end
		end
		for i, axisKey in ipairs(axes) do
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = axisKey .. "Pill"
			b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11; b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillW, 0, 22)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * (pillW + 4), 0, 56)
			b.Parent = panel; W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b)
			pillAxes[b] = axisKey
			pills[#pills + 1] = b
			-- Shift-click makes the axis the primary (followers re-anchor); a plain click toggles its link.
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
				local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
				if shift then
					primary = axisKey; linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					for _, other in ipairs(axes) do
						if other ~= primary and linkMap[other] ~= nil then linkMap[other] = primary end
						dirtyAxes[other] = true
					end
				elseif axisKey ~= primary then
					if linkMap[axisKey] == primary then linkMap[axisKey] = nil
					else linkMap[axisKey] = primary end
					dirtyAxes[axisKey] = true
				end
				refreshPills()
			end)
		end
		refreshPills()

		local primaryHint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); primaryHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		primaryHint.Text = "(shift-click an axis to make it primary)"; primaryHint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		primaryHint.Font = T.Font; primaryHint.TextSize = 9; primaryHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		primaryHint.ZIndex = 201; primaryHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12); primaryHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84)
		primaryHint.Parent = panel

		local function makeBtn(text, x)
			local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22); b.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 201; b.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0, 4)); W.addStroke(b); return b
		end
		local setBtn = makeBtn("Set", 0); local cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(linkMap, dirtyAxes) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- One pill per kind: lit = the property acts on that kind. A click flips it.
	local function openApplyPanel(opts)
		closeActive()
		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles] ConfigPanel: missing ScreenGui")
			return
		end
		local kinds = opts.kinds or {}
		if #kinds == 0 then return end

		local PANEL_WIDTH = 280
		local PILL_HEIGHT = 22
		local MOST_PER_ROW = 4
		local pillGap = 4
		-- More kinds than fit one row are split evenly over two.
		local perRow = #kinds
		if perRow > MOST_PER_ROW then
			perRow = math.ceil(#kinds / 2)
		end
		local pillRows = math.ceil(#kinds / perRow)
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "ConfigPanel_ApplyTo"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, 122 + (pillRows - 1) * (PILL_HEIGHT + pillGap))
		panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)

		local function makeLine(text, color, textSize, top, height)
			local line = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			line.Text = text
			line.TextColor3 = color
			line.Font = T.Font
			line.TextSize = textSize
			line.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			line.ZIndex = 201
			line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
			line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
			line.Parent = panel
			return line
		end
		makeLine(opts.title or "Apply to", T.Gold, 12, 0, 16)
		makeLine("for: " .. tostring(opts.context or ""), T.MutedGold, 10, 18, 14)
		makeLine("Lit = this property acts on it. Click to switch.", T.DarkGold, 9, 36, 12)

		local applies = {}
		for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
			applies[kind.key] = not (opts.applies and opts.applies[kind.key] == false)
		end

		local pillWidth = math.floor((PANEL_WIDTH - 16 - (perRow - 1) * pillGap) / perRow)
		for index, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
			local column = (index - 1) % perRow
			local row = math.floor((index - 1) / perRow)
			local pill = Instance.new("TextButton")
			pill.Name = kind.key .. "Pill"
			pill.Font = T.Font
			pill.TextSize = 11
			pill.Text = kind.label
			pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
			pill.ZIndex = 201
			pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, pillWidth, 0, PILL_HEIGHT)
			pill.Position = UDim2.new(0, column * (pillWidth + pillGap), 0, 54 + row * (PILL_HEIGHT + pillGap))
			pill.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(pill, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(pill)
			local function paint()
				if applies[kind.key] then
					pill.BackgroundColor3 = T.BrightGold
					pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0
					pill.TextColor3 = T.PanelBg
				else
					pill.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
					pill.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
					pill.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
				end
			end
			paint()
			pill.Activated:Connect(function()
				applies[kind.key] = not applies[kind.key]
				paint()
			end)
		end

		local function makeButton(text, scaleX)
			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			button.Text = text
			button.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			button.Font = T.Font
			button.TextSize = 11
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 0, 22)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(scaleX, scaleX == 0 and 0 or 3, 1, -22)
			button.BorderSizePixel = 0
			button.ZIndex = 201
			button.Parent = panel
			W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(0, 4))
			W.addStroke(button)
			return button
		end
		local setButton = makeButton("Set", 0)
		local cancelButton = makeButton("Cancel", 0.5)

		local function close(commit)
			panel:Destroy()
			if _activePanel and _activePanel.frame == panel then _activePanel = nil end
			if commit and opts.onSet then opts.onSet(applies) end
			if not commit and opts.onCancel then opts.onCancel() end
		end
		setButton.Activated:Connect(function() close(true) end)
		cancelButton.Activated:Connect(function() close(false) end)
		_activePanel = { frame = panel, close = function() close(false) end }
		return _activePanel
	end

	-- init.server.lua's SelectionChanged hook skips handleSelection while this is true: the picker
	-- reads Selection for its target while the Properties panel stays on the items being configured.
	local function isOpen() return _activePanel ~= nil end

	return {
		openInstancePicker = openInstancePicker,
		openAxisLinkPanel = openAxisLinkPanel,
		openApplyPanel = openApplyPanel,
		closeActive = closeActive,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

function Constants.presetNamed(name)
	for _, preset in ipairs(Constants.THEME_PRESETS) do
		if preset.name == name then
			return preset
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Colours alike to the eye: a hex round trip moves a channel by 1/255 at most.
local function sameColor(first, second)
	return first ~= nil and second ~= nil
		and math.abs(first.R - second.R) < 0.02
		and math.abs(first.G - second.G) < 0.02
		and math.abs(first.B - second.B) < 0.02
end

-- The preset whose saved colours `colors` (accent, bg, blob, slider, scrollBar) are, or nil.
function Constants.presetMatching(colors)
	for _, preset in ipairs(Constants.THEME_PRESETS) do
		if sameColor(colors.accent, preset.accent) and sameColor(colors.bg, preset.bg)
			and sameColor(colors.blob, preset.blob) and sameColor(colors.slider, preset.slider)
			and sameColor(colors.scrollBar, preset.scrollBar) then
			return preset.name
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local MONO_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderMono.json"
local SOFT_FAMILY = "rbxasset://fonts/families/Nunito.json"

-- The body face at the given weight (rows, labels, buttons): Builder Sans, or Custom's body font.
function Constants.bodyFont(weight)
	local fonts = Constants.MODE.Fonts
	return Font.new(fonts and fonts.body or BODY_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
end

-- A theme font setting (an Enum.Font name or a family's asset id) as a family; nil when Roblox lacks it.
function Constants.fontFamily(value)
	local id = string.match(value, "^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
	if id then
		return Font.fromId(tonumber(id)).Family
	end
	local font = ThemeSchema.fontEnum(value)
	if font then
		return Font.fromEnum(font).Family
	end
	return nil
end

-- Custom's font families by text role, from the theme document; nil when it sets none.
local function customFonts(doc)
	local fonts = nil
	for _, role in ipairs(ThemeSchema.FONT_ROLES) do
		local value = ThemeSchema.get(doc, "custom.fonts." .. role)
		local family = value ~= nil and Constants.fontFamily(value) or nil
		if family then
			fonts = fonts or {}
			fonts[role] = family
		end
	end
	return fonts
end

-- Builder Mono keeps digits in columns. It ships Light, Regular and Bold only.
function Constants.monoFont(weight)
	return Font.new(MONO_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
end

-- Nunito, a rounded face, for chips. Its weights share letter widths, so all are measured with
-- SOFT_MEASURE_FONT (GetTextSize takes an Enum.Font; only Regular has one).
function Constants.softFont(weight)
	return Font.new(SOFT_FAMILY, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
end
Constants.SOFT_MEASURE_FONT = Enum.Font.Nunito

-- The theme font at the given weight; a family without that weight draws its nearest one.
function Constants.themeFont(weight)
	local base = Font.fromEnum(Constants.T.Font)
	return Font.new(base.Family, weight or Enum.FontWeight.Regular, base.Style)
end

-- Custom's roles, structure and metrics from the theme document, as the modes hold them.
local function customOverrides(doc)
	local custom = type(doc) == "table" and doc.custom
	if type(custom) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local out = { base = custom.base, roles = {}, structure = {}, metrics = {} }
	for role, hex in pairs(custom.roles or {}) do
		out.roles[role] = Constants.hexToColor3(hex)
	end
	for key, value in pairs(custom.structure or {}) do
		if string.sub(key, -6) == "Weight" then
			out.structure[key] = Enum.FontWeight[value]
		else
			out.structure[key] = value
		end
	end
	for key, value in pairs(custom.metrics or {}) do
		out.metrics[key] = value
	end
	return out
end

-- Between a switch's knob and the ends of its track: WidgetToggle draws it, refresh fits the knob.
local TOGGLE_KNOB_INSET = 2
Constants.TOGGLE_KNOB_INSET = TOGGLE_KNOB_INSET

-- The layout as one string (mode, metrics, structure, Custom's fonts); UpdateTheme relays the UI
-- when it changes.
function Constants.layoutKey()
	local parts = { tostring(Constants.MODE.Id) }
	for _, source in ipairs({ Constants.LAYOUT, Constants.MODE.Structure or {}, Constants.MODE.Fonts or {} }) do
		local keys = {}
		for key in pairs(source) do
			table.insert(keys, key)
		end
		table.sort(keys)
		for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
			table.insert(parts, key .. "=" .. tostring(source[key]))
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ";")
end

function Constants.refresh()
	local T = Constants.T
	local LAYOUT = Constants.LAYOUT
	local resolved = ThemeModes.resolve({
		panel = T.InputBg,
		field = T.InputBlob,
		accent = T.InputAccent,
		text = T.TextAccent,
		slider = T.InputSlider,
		scrollBar = T.InputScrollBar,
	}, T.Mode, T.TextSize, T.Mode == "Custom" and customOverrides(T.Doc) or nil)

	T.Mode = resolved.Id
	T.TextSize = ThemeModes.textSize(T.TextSize)
	Constants.MODE.Id = resolved.Id
	Constants.MODE.Base = resolved.Base
	Constants.MODE.Structure = resolved.Structure
	Constants.MODE.Fonts = resolved.Id == "Custom" and customFonts(T.Doc) or nil

	local surface = resolved.Surface
	T.PanelAlpha = surface.UsesSavedAlpha and T.InputPanelAlpha or surface.PanelAlpha
	-- Solid panels would hide the background image (Widgets.attachPanelBackground): with one they thin out.
	if not surface.UsesSavedAlpha and (T.BgImage ~= "" and T.BgImageTransparency < 1 or resolved.Id == "Custom" and ThemeSchema.imageLayerShows(T.Doc, "panel")) then
		T.PanelAlpha = Constants.PANEL_ALPHA_OVER_IMAGE
	end
	T.BlobAlpha = surface.UsesSavedAlpha and T.InputBlobAlpha or surface.BlobAlpha
	T.BorderAlpha = surface.BorderAlpha

	-- Inverted: every role in the other polarity (Skin follows Constants.Inversion); not in Classic.
	local roles = resolved.Roles
	Constants.Inversion = nil
	if not resolved.Structure.Classic and ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "invert") == true then
		roles, Constants.Inversion = ThemeModes.Invert.roles(roles)
	end
	-- Hue: every role but the status colours turned round the hue circle (Skin follows HueTurn).
	Constants.HueBase = roles.Accent
	Constants.HueTurn = nil
	local turn = not resolved.Structure.Classic and tonumber(ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "hue")) or 0
	if turn % 360 ~= 0 then
		roles = ThemeModes.turnHue(roles, turn)
		Constants.HueTurn = turn
	end
	for role, color in pairs(roles) do
		T[role] = color
	end
	T.PanelBg = T.Panel
	T.BlobBg = T.Field
	T.Border = T.Outline
	T.BrightGold = T.TextPrimary
	T.Gold = T.TextHeading
	T.MutedGold = T.TextLabel
	T.DarkGold = T.TextSecondary
	T.Green = T.Success
	T.Red = T.Danger

	-- Classic keeps the base axis colours; other modes lift each to read clearly on a field.
	local ColorMath = ThemeModes.ColorMath
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(T.Panel)
	for axis, base in pairs(Constants.AXIS_BASE) do
		if resolved.Structure.Classic then
			T["Axis" .. axis] = base
		else
			local _, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(base)
			T["Axis" .. axis] = ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(light and 0.50 or 0.80, math.min(chroma, 0.14), hue, { T.Field }, 5, light)
		end
	end

	for name, value in pairs(resolved.Metrics) do
		LAYOUT[name] = value
	end
	-- One size pair serves both toggle shapes: a knob fits its track, a checkbox is square, a switch
	-- leaves its knob room to slide.
	LAYOUT.Knob = math.min(LAYOUT.Knob, LAYOUT.ToggleHeight - TOGGLE_KNOB_INSET * 2)
	if resolved.Structure.Toggle == "Check" then
		LAYOUT.ToggleWidth = LAYOUT.ToggleHeight
	else
		LAYOUT.ToggleWidth = math.max(LAYOUT.ToggleWidth, LAYOUT.ToggleHeight + LAYOUT.Knob)
	end
	LAYOUT.RowHeight = LAYOUT.Row
	LAYOUT.SectionHead = LAYOUT.GroupHead
	LAYOUT.ContentOffset = LAYOUT.RowIndent + LAYOUT.LabelWidth + LAYOUT.LabelGap
	T.Corner = UDim.new(0, LAYOUT.Corner)
	T.BigCorner = UDim.new(0, LAYOUT.BigCorner)
end

--[[
	DeckSplit  -  lets a tool deck come apart into one panel per page, and back.
	DeckSplit.attach(W, deck) builds one hidden panel per page (title "<deck title> <page label>", its
	own close / minimize / resize, and a merge button) and adds to deck.api:
	  setSplit(on)   on: each page into its own panel, the shown ones side by side where the deck
	                 was; off: the pages go back into the deck
	  isSplit()
	  solos()        { [pageKey] = panel }
	While split, show / hide / toggle / setTab act on the page panels (WidgetDeck routes them here), a
	page frame is Visible exactly when its panel is (QOLWiring and SelectionHandler read it), and the
	deck frame stays hidden. The deck frame's Split attribute mirrors the state (PanelPersistence saves it).
	deck is WidgetDeck.makeDeck's: { sg, frame, chrome (its ToolShell; page frames live in a shell's
	  body), title, pages, pageFrames, heights, width, minWidth (numbers or functions), api, getActive,
	  setActive, syncPages }
	A page panel is no narrower than deck.minWidth, its header buttons and a few letters of its title.
	Mutates the deck's LIVE page frames: Parent and Visible.
]]

local DeckSplit = {}

-- "Pull apart" on the deck, "put together" on a page panel. The theme fonts carry these glyphs.
local SPLIT_TEXT = "\u{25C0}\u{25B6}"
local MERGE_TEXT = "\u{25B6}\u{25C0}"
local PANEL_GAP = 4
-- Width a page panel's title keeps beside its header buttons at the panel's narrowest.
local TITLE_ROOM = 40

function DeckSplit.attach(W, deck)
	local api = deck.api
	local solos = {}
	local split = false

	for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
		local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(deck.sg, deck.frame.Name .. page.key, deck.width, function()
			return deck.heights[page.key]
		end)
		panel.Name = deck.frame.Name .. page.key
		local title = (deck.title and (deck.title .. " ") or "") .. page.label
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", title)
		chrome.addButton("Split", MERGE_TEXT, function() api.setSplit(false) end)
		chrome.title.Text = title
		W.lay(chrome.title, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth() + 4), 1, 0)
		end)
		chrome.title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		local padding = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
		W.setResizeMinimum(panel, function()
			local sidePadding = 0
			if padding then
				sidePadding = padding.PaddingLeft.Offset + padding.PaddingRight.Offset
			end
			return math.max(W.measure(deck.minWidth), chrome.controlsWidth() + TITLE_ROOM + sidePadding)
		end)
		panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if split then deck.pageFrames[page.key].Visible = panel.Visible end
		end)
		solos[page.key] = panel
	end

	local function anySoloShowing()
		for _, panel in pairs(solos) do
			if panel.Visible then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Opens the page panels in `keys` side by side, starting at the deck's place.
	local function openSideBySide(keys)
		local origin = deck.frame.Position
		local offset = 0
		for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local panel = solos[key]
			panel.Position = origin + UDim2.fromOffset(offset, 0)
			panel.Visible = true
			offset += panel.Size.X.Offset + PANEL_GAP
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
		end
	end

	function api.setSplit(on)
		if on == split then return end
		if on then
			local wasShowing = deck.frame.Visible
			split = true
			deck.frame.Visible = false
			for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
				local pageFrame = deck.pageFrames[page.key]
				local panel = solos[page.key]
				panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, deck.frame.Size.X.Offset, 0, deck.heights[page.key])
				pageFrame.Parent = W.toolChrome(panel).body
				pageFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pageFrame.Visible = false
			end
			if wasShowing then
				local keys = {}
				for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do table.insert(keys, page.key) end
				openSideBySide(keys)
			end
		else
			local reopen = anySoloShowing()
			local first = nil
			for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do
				local panel = solos[page.key]
				if panel.Visible and not first then first = page.key end
				deck.heights[page.key] = panel.Size.Y.Offset
				panel.Visible = false
				deck.pageFrames[page.key].Parent = deck.chrome.body
			end
			split = false
			if first then deck.setActive(first) end
			deck.syncPages()
			if reopen then api.show() end
		end
		deck.frame:SetAttribute("Split", split)
	end

	function api.isSplit()
		return split
	end

	function api.solos()
		return solos
	end

	-- Split-mode versions of the deck calls; WidgetDeck asks `handles(key)` first.
	local routed = {}
	function routed.show(key)
		if key and solos[key] then
			W.restoreChip(solos[key])
			solos[key].Visible = true
			deck.setActive(key)
			task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(solos[key]) end)
			return
		end
		local keys = {}
		for _, page in ipairs(deck.pages) do table.insert(keys, page.key) end
		openSideBySide(keys)
	end
	function routed.hide()
		for _, panel in pairs(solos) do panel.Visible = false end
	end
	function routed.toggle(key)
		if key and solos[key] then
			if solos[key].Visible then solos[key].Visible = false else routed.show(key) end
			return
		end
		if anySoloShowing() then routed.hide() else routed.show() end
	end
	function routed.setTab(key)
		if solos[key] then deck.setActive(key) end
	end

	-- A path that shows the deck itself while split (a stale tray chip) opens the page panels.
	deck.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if split and deck.frame.Visible then
			deck.frame.Visible = false
			routed.show()
		end
	end)

	deck.chrome.addButton("Split", SPLIT_TEXT, function() api.setSplit(true) end)
	deck.frame:SetAttribute("Split", false)
	return {
		isSplit = function() return split end,
		routed = routed,
		solos = solos,
	}
end

return DeckSplit

--[[
	HitFilterPanel  -  modal for the type-level Hit Filter row (Modules/Part/HitFilter): a Collision
	Group dropdown (RaycastParams.CollisionGroup: PhysicsService's registered groups and "(none)") and
	an Exclude List (FilterDescendantsInstances: each Instance and its descendants).
	OnHit, Rocks, Lightning Seek and a Reactor's pieces read the same filter. Writes go to EVERY item
	in opts.items, one undo step per open-close. Add uses ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker.
	Returns { open(opts), close(), isOpen() }; opts = { items = {...}, onClose = function? }
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

return function(deps)
	local W = deps.W
	local T = deps.T
	local ConfigPanel = deps.ConfigPanel
	local EventsSchema = deps.EventsSchema
	local HitFilter = deps.HitFilter
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService

	local _activePanel = nil
	-- True while a session collects writes: closeActive sets the closing waypoint only then.
	local _sessionActive = false
	-- Fired when a session closes, so the Events panel's Hit Filter label refreshes.
	local _onCloseCallback = nil

	local function closeActive()
		local fireCallback = _sessionActive and _onCloseCallback
		if _sessionActive then
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Hit Filter")
			_sessionActive = false
		end
		_onCloseCallback = nil
		if _activePanel then
			pcall(function() _activePanel:Destroy() end)
			_activePanel = nil
		end
		if fireCallback then pcall(fireCallback) end
	end

	-- Registered group names with "(none)" prepended. PhysicsService returns {{id, name, mask}, ...}.
	local function collectGroupNames()
		local out = { "(none)" }
		local ok, groups = pcall(function() return PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() end)
		if ok and type(groups) == "table" then
			for _, g in ipairs(groups) do
				if type(g) == "table" and type(g.name) == "string" then
					table.insert(out, g.name)
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end

	-- Union of every selected item's excludes, deduped.
	local function gatherExcludes(items)
		local seen = {}
		local list = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local _, excludes = HitFilter.read(item)
			for _, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				if not seen[inst] then
					seen[inst] = true
					table.insert(list, inst)
				end
			end
		end
		return list
	end

	-- Mutators run inside an open modal session; the open/close waypoints bracket them into one undo step.
	local function addExcludeToAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function removeExcludeFromAll(items, inst)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.removeExclude(item, inst) end
	end

	local function setGroupOnAll(items, groupName)
		local value = (groupName == "(none)") and "" or groupName
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do HitFilter.setGroup(item, value) end
	end

	-- nil = mixed, "" = none, else the shared group name.
	local function commonGroup(items)
		local first, set = nil, false
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local v = HitFilter.read(item)
			if not set then first = v; set = true
			elseif v ~= first then return nil end
		end
		return first
	end

	local function open(opts)
		closeActive()
		if not opts or not opts.items or #opts.items == 0 then return end

		-- Only raycasting types carry a filter: say so rather than open a dead modal.
		local originalCount = #opts.items
		local filteredItems = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(opts.items) do
			if EventsSchema.isValidForItem(item, "OnHit") or HitFilter.appliesWithoutEvents(item) then
				table.insert(filteredItems, item)
			end
		end
		if #filteredItems == 0 then
			Log.print("[Part-Icles] Hit Filter not applicable to this selection  -  Beam / PointLight / Trail / screens do not raycast.")
			return
		end
		opts.items = filteredItems

		local screenGui = W.getScreenGui and W.getScreenGui() or deps.screenGui
		if not screenGui then return end

		-- Before any UI: writes up to closeActive's waypoint make one undo step.
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Hit Filter")
		_sessionActive = true
		_onCloseCallback = opts.onClose
		-- Per-event filters move to the type level in the same undo step.
		for _, item in ipairs(filteredItems) do HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item) end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = "HitFilterPanel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg

		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 280)

		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.ZIndex = 200
		panel.Active = true
		panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
		panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
		panel.Parent = screenGui
		W.addCorner(panel)
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, 8, 8, 8, 8)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		_activePanel = panel

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "Hit Filter"
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.Font = T.Font
		title.TextSize = 12
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 201
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		title.Parent = panel

		-- Covers the title bar but the close X: ZIndex 201 is above the image overlay, below the close (202).
		local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
		dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dragHandle.Text = ""
		dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
		dragHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		dragHandle.ZIndex = 201
		dragHandle.Parent = panel
		W.makeDraggable(panel, dragHandle)

		local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		closeBtn.Text = "X"
		closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		closeBtn.Font = T.Font
		closeBtn.TextSize = 12
		closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0)
		closeBtn.ZIndex = 202
		closeBtn.Parent = panel

		-- "Applies to N of M" notice when the selection includes items without a filter.
		if #filteredItems < originalCount then
			local notice = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			notice.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			notice.Text = ("Filter applies to %d of %d selected items"):format(#filteredItems, originalCount)
			notice.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			notice.Font = T.Font
			notice.TextSize = 9
			notice.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			notice.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			notice.ZIndex = 201
			notice.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
			notice.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
			notice.Parent = panel
		end

		local cgLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		cgLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgLbl.Text = "Collision Group"
		cgLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold

		cgLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		cgLbl.ZIndex = 201
		cgLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 22)

		cgLbl.Parent = panel

		local cgWrap = Instance.new("Frame")
		cgWrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cgWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 104, 0, 22)
		cgWrap.ZIndex = 201
		cgWrap.Parent = panel

		local groupNames = collectGroupNames()
		local currentGroup = commonGroup(opts.items)
		local defaultText
		if currentGroup == nil then defaultText = "~"
		elseif currentGroup == "" then defaultText = "(none)"
		else defaultText = currentGroup end
		local cgLblWidget, cgFrame, cgSetOnChanged = W.makeDropdown("CGroup", cgWrap, groupNames, defaultText)

		if currentGroup == nil then cgLblWidget.Text = "~" end

			setGroupOnAll(opts.items, picked)
		end)

		local exHdr = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		scroll.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 160)
		scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
		scroll.ZIndex = 201
		scroll.Parent = panel
		W.addCorner(scroll, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(scroll, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		listLayout.Parent = scroll

		local function renderList()
			for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
				if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local excludes = gatherExcludes(opts.items)
			if #excludes == 0 then
				local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				empty.Text = "(no excludes)"
				empty.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
				empty.Font = T.Font
				empty.TextSize = 10
				empty.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				empty.LayoutOrder = 0
				empty.ZIndex = 202
				empty.Parent = scroll
				return
			end
			for i, inst in ipairs(excludes) do
				local row = Instance.new("Frame")
				row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				row.LayoutOrder = i
				row.ZIndex = 202
				row.Parent = scroll

				local pathLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				pathLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				pathLbl.Text = inst:GetFullName()
				pathLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
				pathLbl.Font = T.Font
				pathLbl.TextSize = 10
				pathLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				pathLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
				pathLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
				pathLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
				pathLbl.ZIndex = 203
				pathLbl.Parent = row

				local rmBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
				rmBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
				rmBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
				rmBtn.Text = "X"
				rmBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
				rmBtn.Font = T.Font
				rmBtn.TextSize = 10
				rmBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
				rmBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
				rmBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
				rmBtn.ZIndex = 203
				rmBtn.Parent = row
				W.addCorner(rmBtn, UDim.new(0, 3))
				rmBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					removeExcludeFromAll(opts.items, inst)
					renderList()
				end)
			end
		end
		renderList()

		local addBtn = W.makeButton("AddExclude", panel, "+ Add Exclude",
			UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), T.Gold)
		addBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -22)
		addBtn.ZIndex = 201
		addBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not ConfigPanel or not ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker then return end
			ConfigPanel.openInstancePicker({
				title = "Add Exclude",
				label = "Pick an Instance the hit raycasts should ignore",
				context = (#opts.items == 1) and opts.items[1]:GetFullName() or (#opts.items .. " items"),
				excludeItems = opts.items,
				onSet = function(picked)
					if picked then
						addExcludeToAll(opts.items, picked)
						renderList()
					end
				end,
			})
		end)

		closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			closeActive()
		end)
	end

	local function close()
		closeActive()
	end

	local function isOpen()
		return _activePanel ~= nil
	end

	return {
		open = open,
		close = close,
		isOpen = isOpen,
	}
end

--[[
	InventoryLayout  -  the Inventory panel. Classic builds InventoryPanel; the other modes build one
	panel: a title bar with the Library / Local switch, the lists as tabs, an image-only tile grid, and
	a bottom row (filter button, search bar, add button in local lists). The multi-select strip and
	the selected tile's details dock between the grid and that row.
	  InventoryLayout.build(screenGui) -> refs
	Refs keep the names InventoryWiring reads in both cases. refs.InvSkin exists outside Classic only:
	the wiring makes tiles, list tabs, menu options and tab states through it, so their geometry lives
	here (Metrics, Skin). refs.InvHome is the panel's place after Reset Layout.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local InventoryPanel = require(script.Parent.InventoryPanel)
local MiniSlider = require(script.Parent.MiniSlider)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local Metrics = require(script.Metrics)
local BottomRow = require(script.BottomRow)
local Bars = require(script.Bars)
local Skin = require(script.Skin)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Between the stacked parts of the panel.
local GAP = 8
-- Room inside the grid for the selection ring of the first row and column.
local RING_ROOM = 2
local SCROLLBAR = 4
local TOOLTIP_HEIGHT = 18
local SLIDER_HEIGHT = 16
local SIZE_LABEL = 36
local MENU_Z = 20

local InventoryLayout = {}

-- The title bar's "more" menu: Export / Import and the size slider; returns a function that closes it.
local function buildMoreMenu(bar, refs, metrics)
	local themed = W.getThemed()

	local more = Instance.new("TextButton")

		local slot = LAYOUT.IconSlot

	end)
	more.ZIndex = 3
	TypeScale.style(more, "Glyph")
	W.paint(more, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	more.Parent = bar.header

	local menu = W.makeMenu(more, "MoreMenu", function()
		return metrics.MoreMenu
	end)
	menu.Active = true
	W.lay(menu, "Position", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -metrics.MoreMenu, 1, 0)
	end)
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z
	refs.InvExportImportBtn = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "ExportImport", "Export / Import", 0)

	local sizeRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	sizeRow.Name = "SizeRow"
	sizeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.lay(sizeRow, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 4)
	end)
	sizeRow.LayoutOrder = 1
	sizeRow.Parent = menu
	W.addPadding(sizeRow, 8, 8, 0, 0)

	local sizeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	sizeLabel.Name = "SizeLabel"
	sizeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sizeLabel.Text = "Size"
	sizeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	sizeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, SIZE_LABEL, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(sizeLabel, "Caption")
	W.paint(sizeLabel, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	sizeLabel.Parent = sizeRow

	local slider = MiniSlider.new(sizeRow, T, {
		name = "Scale", min = 0.3, max = 1.5, default = 1,
		width = metrics.MoreMenu - SIZE_LABEL - 24, height = SLIDER_HEIGHT, zIndex = MENU_Z + 1,
	})
	W.lay(slider.frame, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, metrics.MoreMenu - SIZE_LABEL - 24, 0, SLIDER_HEIGHT)
	end)
	slider.frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	slider.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, SIZE_LABEL, 0.5, 0)

	table.insert(themed.fills, slider.fill)
	for _, connection in ipairs(slider.conns) do
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), connection)

	local function close()
		menu.Visible = false

-- The tile grid (InventoryWiring/Grid virtualizes it and sets the canvas) and its loading, empty and

-- Name of the tile under the cursor; a child of the panel, as Grid.luau places it from its corner.
local function buildTooltip(panel, refs)
	local tooltip = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tooltip.Name = "Tooltip"
	tooltip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tooltip.Text = ""
	tooltip.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X

	tooltip.Visible = false

local function buildModern(screenGui)
	local metrics = Metrics.live()
	local refs = {}
	local skin = Skin.new(metrics)
	refs.InvSkin = skin

	-- Room for Columns x Rows tiles: a tile's right gap covers the ring room and the last column's
	-- scrollbar.
	local function gridTop()
		return LAYOUT.TitleBar + metrics.TabRow + GAP
	end
	local function width()
		return metrics.Columns * (metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap) + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2
	end
	local function height()
		local cell = metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap + metrics.TileName
		return gridTop() + metrics.Rows * cell + GAP + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2
	end

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "InventoryPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.layProps(panel, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width() / 2, 0.08, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, width(), 0, height()) }
	end)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	panel.Active = true
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, "Big")
	W.addStroke(panel)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	W.makeResizable(panel, function()
		return metrics.MinWidth
	end, function()
		return metrics.MinHeight
	end)
	-- Its grid scrolls, so it gives way to a panel opened over it (PanelPush).
	W.allowPush(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight)
	refs.InventoryPanel = panel
	W.layEach(panel, function()
		refs.InvHome = UDim2.new(0.5, -width() / 2, 0.08, 0)
	end)

	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Name = "PanelScale"
	panelScale.Parent = panel
	refs.InvScale = panelScale

	-- Everything but the tooltip and dialogs sits inside the padding; the panel has no UIPadding, so
	-- what the wiring places from its corner needs no offset.
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.layProps(content, function()
		local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad), Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, -pad * 2) }
	end)
	content.Parent = panel

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(content, "Inventory", 0)
	W.lay(bar.title, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, metrics.Title, 1, 0)
	end)
	-- Its menu drops over the tabs and the grid.
	bar.header.Parent.ZIndex = 10
	refs.InventoryClose = bar.close
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	local closeMore = buildMoreMenu(bar, refs, metrics)

	-- Two segmented strips Skin.buildLists fills: the Library / Local switch and the list tabs.
	local groupSwitch = W.makeSegmentStrip(bar.header, "Groups")
	groupSwitch.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	groupSwitch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	W.layProps(groupSwitch, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.IconSlot * 2 + GAP), 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar - 8) }
	end)
	groupSwitch.ZIndex = 3

	local listTabs = W.makeSegmentStrip(content, "Lists")
	W.layProps(listTabs, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow) }
	end)
	skin.setListHosts(groupSwitch, listTabs)

	local grid = buildGrid(content, refs)
	buildTooltip(panel, refs)
	local _, setTabsShown, closeAdd = BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)
	local selection = Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics)
	skin.selection = selection
	local detail = Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics)

	-- From the bottom up: the bottom row, the details card, the multi-select strip; the grid takes the rest.
	local function layoutBody()
		local docked = LAYOUT.Search + GAP
		detail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if detail.Visible then
			docked += Bars.detailHeight(metrics) + GAP
		end
		selection.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if selection.frame.Visible then
			docked += Bars.selectionHeight() + GAP
		end
		local top = gridTop()
		grid.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
		grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(top + docked))
	end
	selection.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	detail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	W.layEach(grid, layoutBody)

	function skin.layout(showTabs)
		setTabsShown(showTabs)
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not panel.Visible then
			closeMore()
			closeAdd()
		end
	end)

	InventoryPanel.buildDialogs(screenGui, panel, refs)
	return refs
end

function InventoryLayout.build(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return InventoryPanel.build(screenGui)
	end
	return buildModern(screenGui)
end

return InventoryLayout

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Bars  -  what docks between the grid and the bottom row of the Inventory outside Classic.
	  Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics) -> { frame, countLbl, editBtn, edit, exportBtn, dissectBtn,
	    deleteBtn, clearBtn }: the multi-select strip, wired and shown by InventorySelect
	  Bars.selectionHeight() -> its height
	  Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics) -> card: the selected tile's preview, name, facts and
	    actions, under the Classic details panel's ref names so InventoryWiring fills it unchanged
	  Bars.detailHeight(metrics) -> its height
	InventoryLayout stacks them and shortens the grid by what is showing.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local EditMenu = require(script.Parent.EditMenu)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Padding inside the details card, also the gap between its two parts.
local DETAIL_PAD = 8
local COLUMN_GAP = 12
local ACTION_GAP = 4
-- Extra height of the name line over a fact line, and the air under it.
local NAME_EXTRA = 4
local NAME_GAP = 2
local EDIT_ICON = 16

-- Air between the strip's top rule and its buttons.
local STRIP_TOP = 8

local Bars = {}

function Bars.selectionHeight()
	return LAYOUT.Row + STRIP_TOP
end

function Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics)
	local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
	strip.Name = "SelActions"
	strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	strip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	W.lay(strip, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Bars.selectionHeight())
	end)
	-- Its Edit menu opens upward over the grid; the bottom row's menus (ZIndex 10) open over it.
	strip.ZIndex = 5
	strip.Visible = false
	strip.Parent = content

	local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
	rule.Name = "Rule"
	rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
	W.paint(rule, "BackgroundColor3", "Divider")
	rule.Parent = strip

	-- The count takes the width the buttons leave.
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, STRIP_TOP)
	W.lay(row, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
	end)
	row.Parent = strip
	W.addListLayout(row, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local count = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	count.Name = "SelCount"
	count.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	count.Text = ""
	count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	count.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	count.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
	count.LayoutOrder = 0
	TypeScale.style(count, "Group")
	W.paint(count, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	count.Parent = row
	local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = count

	local editBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelEdit", "Edit", 1)
	return {
		frame = strip,
		countLbl = count,
		editBtn = editBtn,
		edit = EditMenu.build(editBtn, strip, function()
			return metrics.MoreMenu
		end, true),
		exportBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelExport", "Export", 2),
		dissectBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelDissect", "Dissect", 3),
		deleteBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelDelete", "Delete", 4, "Red"),
		clearBtn = W.makeTextButton(row, "SelClear", "Clear", 5, "TextSecondary"),
	}
end

function Bars.detailHeight(metrics)
	return metrics.Preview + metrics.ActionRow + DETAIL_PAD * 3
end

-- One "label  value" facts line: valueClass TextLabel, or TextBox for selectable text; rightInset
-- keeps room for a control at its end.
local function makeFact(facts, metrics, order, labelText, valueClass, rightInset)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = labelText .. "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.Parent = facts
	-- The keywords line sizes itself (buildFacts): its height is laid there.
	if labelText ~= "Keywords" then
		W.lay(row, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow)
		end)
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = labelText
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	W.lay(label, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	end)
	TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
	W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	label.Parent = row

	local value = Instance.new(valueClass)
	value.Name = "Value"
	value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	value.BorderSizePixel = 0
	value.Text = ""
	value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	value.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	value.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	W.layProps(value, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(W.measure(rightInset) + metrics.FactLabel), 1, 0) }
	end)
	TypeScale.style(value, "Value")
	W.paint(value, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	if valueClass == "TextBox" then
		value.TextEditable = false
		value.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	end
	value.Parent = row
	return value, label, row
end

-- The tile's image, or the 3D view InventoryWiring fills for assets and mesh frames.
local function buildPreview(inner, refs, metrics)
	local corner = UDim.new(0, metrics.TileCorner)

	local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
	slot.Name = "PreviewSlot"
	slot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.lay(slot, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, metrics.Preview, 0, metrics.Preview)

	W.paint(slot, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
	slot.Parent = inner
	W.addCorner(slot, corner)
	W.addStroke(slot)

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Name = "Preview"
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.BorderSizePixel = 0
	image.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	image.Parent = slot

	local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")

	W.addCorner(viewport, corner)
	refs.InvAssetViewport = viewport
end

-- Name on top (a text box: local entries rename in place), then the facts; the wiring relabels lines.
local function buildFacts(inner, refs, metrics)
	local function nameHeight()
		return metrics.FactRow + NAME_EXTRA
	end
	local function closeRoom()
		return LAYOUT.IconSlot + 4
	end

	local column = Instance.new("Frame")
	column.Name = "Facts"
	column.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.layProps(column, function()
		local left = metrics.Preview + COLUMN_GAP
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 0, metrics.Preview) }
	end)
	column.Parent = inner

	local name = Instance.new("TextBox")
	name.Name = "Name"
	name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	name.BorderSizePixel = 0
	name.Text = ""
	name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	name.TextEditable = false
	name.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	W.lay(name, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, -(EDIT_ICON + 4 + closeRoom()), 0, nameHeight())
	end)
	TypeScale.style(name, "Group")
	W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	name.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailName = name

	local editIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	editIcon.Name = "EditIcon"
	editIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	editIcon.Text = "\u{270F}"
	editIcon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	W.layProps(editIcon, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(1, -closeRoom(), 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, EDIT_ICON, 0, nameHeight()) }
	end)
	editIcon.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(editIcon, "Caption")
	W.paint(editIcon, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	editIcon.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailEditIcon = editIcon

	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Name = "DetailClose"
