--[[
	InventoryLayout/BottomRow  -  the Inventory's bottom row outside Classic: a round filter button,
	the search bar with its result count, and in local lists a round add button.
	  BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin) -> row, setTabsShown(shown), closeMenus()
	The filter popover holds the filter tabs (All / Static / Flipbook / Favs / Recent; hidden through
	setTabsShown) over the option list InventoryWiring fills, and follows that list's Visible.
	The add button's menu (refs.InvToolbar) holds Import Selected, the import options, Upload and
	Dissect; the wiring shows the ones a list has. Both open upward as children of their button, so
	they follow it when the row reflows.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local GAP = 8
local MENU_Z = 20
-- Gap between a round button and the popover above it.
local POPOVER_LIFT = 6
-- Bars of the filter icon, widest first.
local FILTER_BARS = { 12, 8, 4 }

local BottomRow = {}

-- A Metrics.live value as a function, for a size that follows the text size (Relayout).
local function metric(metrics, key)
	return function()
		return metrics[key]
	end
end

-- size: a function that follows the layout.
local function makeCircle(row, name, size, order)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = ""
	button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.lay(button, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, size(), 0, size())
	end)
	button.LayoutOrder = order
	button.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(1, 0))
	W.addStroke(button)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, button)
	W.wireFieldStates(button)
	return button
end

local function buildFilter(row, refs, metrics, skin)
	local button = makeCircle(row, "FilterBtn", metric(metrics, "Circle"), 1)
	refs.InvFilterBtn = button

	-- Three bars narrowing downward, drawn: the plugin has no icon images.
	local lines = {}
	for index, width in ipairs(FILTER_BARS) do
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Bar" .. index
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (index - 2) * 4)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 2)
		line.Parent = button
		W.addCorner(line, UDim.new(1, 0))
		lines[index] = line
	end
	skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)

	local popover = W.makeMenu(button, "FilterPopover", metric(metrics, "FilterMenu"))
	popover.Active = true
	popover.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	popover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -POPOVER_LIFT)
	popover.ZIndex = MENU_Z

	local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
	tabs.Name = "Tabs"
	tabs.BorderSizePixel = 0
	W.lay(tabs, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow)
	end)
	tabs.LayoutOrder = 0
	W.paint(tabs, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
	tabs.Parent = popover
	W.addCorner(tabs)
	W.addPadding(tabs, 2, 2, 2, 2)
	W.addListLayout(tabs, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.TabAll = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabAll", "All", 0)
	refs.TabStatic = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabStatic", "Static", 1)
	refs.TabFlipbook = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFlipbook", "Flipbook", 2)
	refs.TabFavourites = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFavourites", "\u{2605} Favs", 3)
	refs.TabRecents = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabRecents", "Recent", 4)
	skin.setActiveTab(refs.TabAll)

	-- As tall as its options up to metrics.MenuMax, then it scrolls.
	local options = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	options.Name = "FilterDropdown"
	options.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	options.BorderSizePixel = 0
	options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	options.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	options.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	options.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	options.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	options.LayoutOrder = 1
	options.Visible = false
	options.Parent = popover
	W.addListLayout(options, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, options)
	refs.InvFilterDropdown = options

	local function fitToOptions()
		local optionStep = LAYOUT.Row - 4 + 2
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(options:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count * optionStep, metrics.MenuMax))
	end
	options.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		popover.Visible = options.Visible
	end)

	return function(shown)
		tabs.Visible = shown
	end
end

local function buildSearch(row, refs, metrics)
	local box, field = W.makeSearchField(row, "Search", "Search...")
	field.Name = "Search"
	W.lay(field, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, LAYOUT.Search)

	field.LayoutOrder = 2
	W.lay(box, "Size", function()

	local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = field
	refs.InvSearch = box

	local count = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	count.Name = "ResultCount"
	count.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	count.Text = ""
	count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	count.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	W.layProps(count, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.SearchCount, 1, 0) }
	end)
	TypeScale.style(count, "Caption")
	W.paint(count, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	count.Parent = field
	refs.InvResultCount = count
end

local function buildAdd(row, refs, metrics)
	local button = makeCircle(row, "Toolbar", metric(metrics, "Circle"), 3)
	button.Text = "+"
	button.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(button, "Group")
	W.paint(button, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
	refs.InvToolbar = button

	local menu = W.makeMenu(button, "AddMenu", metric(metrics, "AddMenu"))
	menu.Active = true
	menu.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	menu.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -POPOVER_LIFT)
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z

	refs.InvToolImport = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Import", "Import Selected", 0)
	refs.InvImportArrow = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "ImportArrow", "Import options \u{25BC}", 1)

	-- Opened by the item above (InventoryWiring toggles its Visible); the options tick in place.
	local options = Instance.new("Frame")
	options.Name = "ImportDropdown"
	options.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	options.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	options.LayoutOrder = 2
	options.Visible = false
	options.Parent = menu
	W.addListLayout(options, 2)
	W.addPadding(options, 12, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.InvImportDropdown = options
	refs.InvOptBundle = W.makeMenuItem(options, "Bundle", "\u{2610} Bundle (import as one)", 0)
	refs.InvOptPaths = W.makeMenuItem(options, "Paths", "\u{2610} Paths (save locations)", 1)

	refs.InvToolUpload = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Upload", "Upload", 3)
	refs.InvToolDissect = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Dissect", "Dissect", 4)

	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
	end)
	local function close()
		menu.Visible = false
	end
	-- An action closes the menu; the wiring's own handlers do the work.
	for _, action in ipairs({ refs.InvToolImport, refs.InvToolUpload, refs.InvToolDissect }) do
		action.Activated:Connect(close)
	end
	return close
end

function BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "BottomRow"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	W.lay(row, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Search)
	end)
	-- Its popovers open upward over the grid and whatever is docked above the row.
	row.ZIndex = 10
	row.Parent = content
	local list = W.addListLayout(row, GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local setTabsShown = buildFilter(row, refs, metrics, skin)
	buildSearch(row, refs, metrics)
	local closeAdd = buildAdd(row, refs, metrics)
	return row, setTabsShown, closeAdd
end

return BottomRow

--[[
	InventoryLayout/EditMenu  -  the Edit button's menu on the Inventory's multi-select strip, alike in
	every mode: what changes on all selected local textures at once.
	  EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp) -> parts: menu (hidden; the wiring shows it),
	    place() (puts it at the button on opening), gridBox (a Grid for every selected texture, set
	    on Enter), list (one row per custom filter), makeRow(name, text, order) -> TextButton
	  EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder) -> TextBox   over a menu row, hidden until shown (a new
	    filter's name, or a rename)
	  EditMenu.addRowTools(row) -> rename, remove       "Rename" and "Delete" at the row's right end
	The menu is a child of `host` (the strip, or the panel in Classic), never of the button: a button
	as wide as its text grows to hold what is inside it. It opens over the grid: upward where the
	strip docks at the bottom, downward in Classic. InventoryWiring/InventoryEdit wires the parts;
	InventoryWiring/InventoryFilters uses the row helpers on the Filters menu's rows.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local MENU_Z = 30
-- Gap between the button and its menu.
local LIFT = 6
local GRID_LABEL = 40
local CAPTION_HEIGHT = 16
-- Rows shown before the list scrolls.
local MAX_ROWS = 6
-- A row tool's width, room for "Delete?": in text sizes, or in pixels in Classic (one caption size).
local TOOL_WIDTH = 3.5
local TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC = 40
local TOOL_GAP = 2
local TOOL_MARGIN = 4

local EditMenu = {}

function EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = "Input"
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Text = ""
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	box.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 2
	box.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(box, "Label")
	W.paint(box, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
	W.paint(box, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	box.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(box)
	return box
end

function EditMenu.addRowTools(row)
	local toolWidth = C.MODE.Structure.Classic and TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC or math.floor(T.TextSize * TOOL_WIDTH)
	local width = toolWidth * 2 + TOOL_GAP

	-- The row's padding keeps its text clear of the tools, which sit in that padding.
	local padding = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	if not padding then
		padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.Parent = row
	end
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, width + TOOL_MARGIN * 2)

	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Tools"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(1, width + TOOL_MARGIN, 0, 0)
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
	holder.Parent = row
	W.addListLayout(holder, TOOL_GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local function makeTool(name, text, order, role)
		local tool = Instance.new("TextButton")
		tool.Name = name
		tool.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tool.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tool.Text = text
		tool.Size = UDim2.new(0, toolWidth, 1, 0)
		tool.LayoutOrder = order
		tool.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
		TypeScale.style(tool, "Caption")
		W.paint(tool, "TextColor3", role)
		tool.Parent = holder
		return tool
	end
	return makeTool("Rename", "Rename", 1, "TextSecondary"), makeTool("Remove", "Delete", 2, "Red")
end

-- width: a number, or a function that follows the layout.
function EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp)
	local menu = W.makeMenu(host, "EditMenu", width)
	menu.Active = true
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z
	menu.AnchorPoint = opensUp and Vector2.new(0, 1) or Vector2.new(1, 0)

	local gridBox = W.makeNumberRow(menu, "Grid", "Grid", "", GRID_LABEL, 0)
	-- InventoryWiring/InventoryEdit puts this hint back after it has shown an answer.
	gridBox.PlaceholderText = "4, 3x2 or 0 for none"
	gridBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	W.makeDivider(menu, 1)

	local caption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	caption.Name = "FiltersCaption"
	caption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	caption.Text = "In filters"
	caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	caption.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CAPTION_HEIGHT)
	caption.LayoutOrder = 2
	TypeScale.style(caption, "Caption")
	W.paint(caption, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	caption.Parent = menu
	W.addPadding(caption, 8, 8, 0, 0)

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Filters"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	list.LayoutOrder = 3
	list.Parent = menu
	W.addListLayout(list, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)

	local function fitToRows()
		local rowStep = LAYOUT.Row - 4 + 2
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count, MAX_ROWS) * rowStep)
	end
	list.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToRows)
	list.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToRows)

	local parts = { menu = menu, gridBox = gridBox, list = list }

	-- Above the button with its left edge on the button's, or below it with its right edge on
	-- the button's. In shares of the host, so no UIScale enters.
	function parts.place()
		local hostSize = host.AbsoluteSize
		if hostSize.X <= 0 or hostSize.Y <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local corner = button.AbsolutePosition - host.AbsolutePosition
		local left = corner.X / hostSize.X
		local top = corner.Y / hostSize.Y
		if opensUp then
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(left, 0, top, -LIFT)
		else
			local right = left + button.AbsoluteSize.X / hostSize.X
			local bottom = top + button.AbsoluteSize.Y / hostSize.Y
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(right, 0, bottom, LIFT)
		end
	end

	function parts.makeRow(name, text, order)
		local row = W.makeMenuItem(list, name, text, order)
		row.ZIndex = MENU_Z + 1
		return row
	end

	return parts
end

return EditMenu

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Skin  -  the parts of the Inventory that InventoryWiring makes and repaints at run
	time outside Classic: grid tiles, list tabs, filter tab and menu-option states.
	  Skin.new(metrics) -> skin, published as refs.InvSkin (Classic has none; the wiring has its own code)
	    skin.metrics                              Metrics.live()
	    skin.makeCell(grid, index) -> cell        what Grid.luau pools: wrapper, img, nameLabel,
	                                              highlight, quickInsert, favStar, typeBadge
	    skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
	    skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)            a flipbook texture shows its grid; nothing else is badged
	    skin.buildLists(groups, onPick)           groups = { { title, modes = { { id, text }, ... } }, ... }:
	                                              a switch segment per group, a tab per list; picking a
	                                              group picks its list of the same name, or its first
	    skin.setActiveList(id)
	    skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order) -> button   a filter tab (All, Static, ...)
	    skin.setActiveTab(button)
	    skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order) -> button
	    skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
	  InventoryLayout assigns skin.layout(showTabs), skin.selection and the hosts (setListHosts /
	  setFilterButton). Active states are kept here and repainted after a theme change.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

local RING = 2
local QUICK = 20
local BADGE_HEIGHT = 16
local ALL_TAB = "TabAll"

local Skin = {}

function Skin.new(metrics)
	local skin = { metrics = metrics }

	local tabs = {}
	local activeTab = nil
	local groupHost = nil
	local listHost = nil
	local groups = {}
	local groupButtons = {}
	local listButtons = {}
	local activeList = nil
	local filterButton = nil
	local filterLines = {}
	-- Option button -> whether it is ticked. Weak keys: the wiring destroys options on every rebuild.
	local optionOn = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function groupOf(listId)
		for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				if pair[1] == listId then
					return index, pair[2]
				end
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	local function paintLists()
		local activeGroup = groupOf(activeList)
		for index, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			W.paintSegment(button, index == activeGroup)
		end
		for listId, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button.Visible = groupOf(listId) == activeGroup
			W.paintSegment(button, listId == activeList)
		end
	end

	-- The filter button is filled while a tab other than All or any option narrows the list.
	local function paintFilterButton()
		if not filterButton then
			return
		end
		local filtering = activeTab ~= nil and activeTab.Name ~= ALL_TAB
		for option, on in pairs(optionOn) do
			if on and option.Parent and option.Name ~= "All" then
				filtering = true
			end
		end
		filterButton.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.Accent or T.BlobBg
		for _, line in ipairs(filterLines) do
			line.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.OnAccent or T.MutedGold
		end
	end

	local function paintTabs()
		for _, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
			W.paintSegment(tab, tab == activeTab)
		end
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- Segments repaint themselves after a theme change (WidgetSegments); the filter button is ours.
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, paintFilterButton)

	function skin.setListHosts(groupFrame, listFrame)
		groupHost = groupFrame
		listHost = listFrame
	end

	function skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)
		filterButton = button
		filterLines = lines
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	function skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order)
		local tab = W.makeSegment(parent, name, text, order, { fill = true })
		table.insert(tabs, tab)
		return tab
	end

	function skin.setActiveTab(button)
		activeTab = button
		paintTabs()
	end

	function skin.buildLists(groupList, onPick)
		for _, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		for _, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		groups = groupList
		groupButtons = {}
		listButtons = {}

		local listOrder = 0
		for groupIndex, group in ipairs(groups) do
			local segment = W.makeSegment(groupHost, group.title, group.title, groupIndex)
			groupButtons[groupIndex] = segment
			segment.Activated:Connect(function()
				local activeGroup, activeText = groupOf(activeList)
				if activeGroup == groupIndex then
					return
				end
				local target = group.modes[1][1]
				for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
					if pair[2] == activeText then
						target = pair[1]
					end
				end
				onPick(target)
			end)

			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				local listId = pair[1]
				listOrder += 1
				local tab = W.makeSegment(listHost, listId, pair[2], listOrder, { fill = true })
				listButtons[listId] = tab
				tab.Activated:Connect(function()
					onPick(listId)
				end)
			end
		end
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.setActiveList(listId)
		activeList = listId
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order)
		return W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, name, order)
	end

	function skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
		button.Text = on and (label .. "  \u{2713}") or label
		button.TextColor3 = on and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
		optionOn[button] = on
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- One grid tile, backing and image apart: InventoryWiring puts a 3D viewport between them for assets.
	function skin.makeCell(grid, index)
		local tile = metrics.Tile
		local corner = UDim.new(0, metrics.TileCorner)

		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
		wrapper.Name = "TW" .. index
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile + metrics.TileGap, 0, tile + metrics.TileName + metrics.TileGap)
		wrapper.Parent = grid

		local backing = Instance.new("Frame")
		backing.Name = "Tile"
		backing.BorderSizePixel = 0
		backing.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		backing.ZIndex = 0
		W.paint(backing, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
		backing.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(backing, corner)
		local outline = W.addStroke(backing)

		local image = Instance.new("ImageButton")
		image.Name = "Thumb"
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		image.BorderSizePixel = 0
		image.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		image.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(image, corner)

		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "HL"
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		ring.ZIndex = 2
		ring.Visible = false
		ring.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(ring, corner)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Thickness = RING
		ringStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		W.paint(ringStroke, "Color", "Focus")
		ringStroke.Parent = ring

		local star = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		star.Name = "Fav"
		star.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		star.Text = "\u{2605}"
		star.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		star.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
		star.ZIndex = 3
		star.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(star, "Caption")
		W.paint(star, "TextColor3", "Focus")
		star.Parent = image

		local quick = Instance.new("TextButton")
		quick.Name = "QI"
		quick.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		quick.BorderSizePixel = 0
		quick.Text = "+"
		quick.Size = UDim2.new(0, QUICK, 0, QUICK)
		quick.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(QUICK + 4), 1, -(QUICK + 4))
		quick.ZIndex = 3
		quick.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(quick, "Button")
		W.paint(quick, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
		quick.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(quick, UDim.new(1, 0))
		W.addStroke(quick)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, quick)

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.Name = "TypeBadge"
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		badge.Text = ""
		badge.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, BADGE_HEIGHT)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -(BADGE_HEIGHT + 4))
		badge.ZIndex = 3
		badge.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(badge, "Caption")
		W.paint(badge, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
		W.paint(badge, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		badge.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(badge, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(badge, 5, 5, 0, 0)

		-- Always present: the wiring writes the entry's name here and the tooltip reads it back.
		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Name = "Name"
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = ""
		name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		name.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, metrics.TileName)
		name.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, tile + 2)
		name.Visible = metrics.TileName > 0
		TypeScale.style(name, "Caption")
		W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		name.Parent = wrapper

		return {
			wrapper = wrapper, img = image, nameLabel = name, highlight = ring,
			quickInsert = quick, favStar = star, typeBadge = badge, outline = outline,
		}
	end

	function skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
		cell.outline.Color = hovered and T.OutlineHover or T.Border
	end

	-- A sheet's badge is its grid, `grid` x `gridRows`, square without rows (as GridText.of reads it).
	function skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)
		local columns = entry.grid
		local rows = entry.gridRows or columns
		local isSheet = entry._type == nil and columns ~= nil and columns * rows > 1
		cell.typeBadge.Visible = isSheet
		if isSheet then
			cell.typeBadge.Text = columns .. "\u{00D7}" .. rows
		end
	end

	return skin
end

return Skin

	local ttp = Instance.new("UIPadding"); ttp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,4); ttp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,4); ttp.Parent = tooltip

	refs.InvTooltip = tooltip

	buildDetail(sg, refs, _themed)
	buildDialogs(sg, panel, refs, _themed)
	return refs
end

end

function InventoryPanel.buildDialogs(sg, panel, refs)

end

--[[
	Compact horizontal slider for panel headers (graph editor and inventory scale): track, fill,
	handle and value label in one frame. Callers theme its parts and disconnect `slider.conns`.
	MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts) -> slider
	  opts: name, min, max, default, width (96), height (16), fmt ("%.2fx"), zIndex (1),
	        labelWidth (28), onChanged(value) per move, onRelease(value) on mouse-up after a drag
	  slider.frame / track / fill / handle / label / conns, set(value, silent), get(),
	  onChanged / onRelease (reassignable)
	MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn, baseScale)
	  A drag shows the panel's outline at the slider's value; applyFn(value) runs on release, as
	  applying live would rescale the slider under the cursor. The outline is baseScale (1) x value.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MiniSlider = {}

local LABEL_W = 28
local TRACK_H = 6

local function addCorner(instance, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = instance
end

function MiniSlider.new(parent, theme, opts)
	local width = opts.width or 96
	local height = opts.height or 16
	local zIndex = opts.zIndex or 1
	local fmt = opts.fmt or "%.2fx"
	local minVal, maxVal = opts.min, opts.max
	local labelWidth = opts.labelWidth or LABEL_W

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = opts.name or "MiniSlider"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	frame.ZIndex = zIndex
	frame.Parent = parent

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Val"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = theme.MutedGold
	label.Font = theme.Font
	label.TextSize = 8
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, labelWidth, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -labelWidth, 0, 0)
	label.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	label.Parent = frame

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Track"
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BlobBg
	track.BackgroundTransparency = theme.BlobAlpha
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(labelWidth + 4), 0, TRACK_H)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -TRACK_H / 2)
	track.ZIndex = zIndex + 1
	track.Parent = frame
	addCorner(track, 3)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SliderFill or theme.Gold
	fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.ZIndex = zIndex + 2
	fill.Parent = track
	addCorner(fill, 3)

	local handle = Instance.new("Frame")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = theme.BrightGold
	handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 10)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
	handle.ZIndex = zIndex + 3
	handle.Parent = track
	addCorner(handle, 4)

	-- One invisible button the full height of the frame catches clicks anywhere along the track.
	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Name = "Hit"
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -height / 2)
	hit.ZIndex = zIndex + 4
	hit.Parent = track

	local slider = { frame = frame, track = track, fill = fill, handle = handle, label = label, conns = {} }
	slider.onChanged = opts.onChanged
	slider.onRelease = opts.onRelease

	local current = opts.default or minVal
	local dragging = false

	function slider.set(value, silent)
		current = math.clamp(value, minVal, maxVal)
		local alpha = (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		label.Text = string.format(fmt, current)
		if not silent and slider.onChanged then slider.onChanged(current) end
	end

	function slider.get()
		return current
	end

	local function updateFromInput(input)
		local trackX, trackW = track.AbsolutePosition.X, track.AbsoluteSize.X
		if trackW <= 0 then return end
		slider.set(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * math.clamp((input.Position.X - trackX) / trackW, 0, 1))
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = true
		updateFromInput(input)
	end)
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then updateFromInput(input) end
	end))
	table.insert(slider.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = false
		if slider.onRelease then slider.onRelease(current) end
	end))

	slider.set(current, true)
	return slider
end

-- Product of the UIScales above `panel` (Position / AbsolutePosition live in that space).
local function outerScale(panel)
	local scale = 1
	local node = panel.Parent
	while node and node:IsA("GuiBase2d") do
		local uiScale = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if uiScale then scale = scale * uiScale.Scale end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return math.max(scale, 0.01)
end

local function makePreview(panel, theme)
	local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
	preview.Name = "ScalePreview"
	preview.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Gold
	preview.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
	preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
	preview.ZIndex = 100
	preview.Visible = false
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = theme.Gold
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = preview
	addCorner(preview, 8)
	preview.Parent = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or panel.Parent
	return preview
end

function MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(slider, panel, theme, applyFn, baseScale)
	local preview
	slider.onChanged = function(value)
		if not preview or not preview.Parent then preview = makePreview(panel, theme) end
		local outer = outerScale(panel)
		local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize / outer / (ownScale and ownScale.Scale or 1) * value * (baseScale or 1)
		local position = panel.AbsolutePosition / outer
		preview.Position = UDim2.new(0, position.X, 0, position.Y)
		preview.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X, 0, size.Y)
		preview.Visible = true
	end
	slider.onRelease = function(value)
		if preview then preview.Visible = false end
		applyFn(value)
	end
end

return MiniSlider

--[[
	Motion  -  the plugin UI's tween timings from the theme: speed, easing and reduced motion. Asked
	at each tween, so a theme change applies to the next one.
	  Motion.reduced() -> whether motion is left out: the theme's `motion.reduce` or the viewer's
	                      Roblox setting (GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled)
	  Motion.seconds(seconds) -> a duration at the theme's speed (`motion.speed` %), 0 when reduced
	  Motion.info(seconds, style, direction) -> a TweenInfo in the theme's easing (`motion.easing`)
	                      where it names one, else the caller's style
	A message shown for a time (the graph editor's action note) is not motion and keeps its own.
]]

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeSchema = require(script.Parent.ThemeSchema)
local T = C.T

local Motion = {}

function Motion.reduced()
	if ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "motion.reduce") then
		return true
	end
	-- ReducedMotionEnabled is hidden and capability-gated: where it cannot be read, motion plays.
	local ok, reduced = pcall(function()
		return GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled
	end)
	return ok and reduced == true
end

function Motion.seconds(seconds)
	if Motion.reduced() then
		return 0
	end
	return seconds * 100 / ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "motion.speed")
end

function Motion.info(seconds, style, direction)
	local easing = ThemeSchema.value(T.Doc, "motion.easing")
	-- ThemeSchema keeps `easing` to its choices, each an Enum.EasingStyle name but "Default".
	if easing ~= "Default" then
		style = Enum.EasingStyle[easing]
	end
	return TweenInfo.new(Motion.seconds(seconds), style, direction)
end

return Motion

--[[
	PanelChrome  -  the shared frame of a panel outside Classic: the panel surface, its title bar and
	the row shapes small panels are made of. Loaded by Widgets.luau; adds to W:
	  makePanel(parent, name, width)              padded panel that grows with its rows
	  makeTitleBar(panel, title, order)           { header, title, close }, the panel's full width
	  makeTitleFill(parent, name) -> bar          the bar alone; its title and controls go in a sibling
	                                              named Header, whose text Skin colours for the bar
	  makeTitleHeader(parent) -> header           that Header, level with the rows, as tall as the bar
	  makeNumberRow(parent, name, label, text, labelWidth, order)   label + right-aligned input
	  makeSwitchRow(parent, name, label, order)                     label + switch at the right
	  makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)         full-width button
	  makeTextButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)           button as wide as its text
	  makeButtonRow(parent, name, specs, order) -> buttons, row     equal buttons side by side
	  makeTextField(parent, name, text, alignment) -> box, field    a bare input field
	  makeSearchField(parent, name, placeholder) -> box, field      search-height field
	  makeDivider(parent, order, air?) / makeGroupBreak(parent, order)   hairlines between row groups
	  makeRowFrame(parent, name, order) / makeRowLabel(row, text, width) a bare row and its label
	  makeMenu(parent, name, width) / makeMenuItem(menu, name, text, order)   a popup menu and its rows
	  makeLoadingList(parent, name) -> list       scrolls; shows "Loading…" until its wiring fills it
	Classic builds its panels with its own code.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)
	-- width: a number that stays, or a function that follows the layout (PanelSizes.of).
	function W.makePanel(parent, name, width)
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = name
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.lay(panel, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(0, W.measure(width), 0, 0)
		end)
		panel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(panel, "Big")
		W.addStroke(panel)
		W.addPadding(panel, "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad")
		W.addListLayout(panel, "RowGap")
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		return panel
	end

	function W.makeTitleHeader(parent)
		local header = Instance.new("Frame")
		header.Name = "Header"
		header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		W.layProps(header, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -LAYOUT.PanelPad), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar) }
		end)
		header.Parent = parent
		return header
	end

	-- From the panel padding past the parent's padding to its edges, with a rule under it. Filled
	-- (TitleBarFill) it rounds its top and a SquareBottom squares its lower corners; plain it is clear.
	-- Custom's title bar layers replace both (Skin).
	function W.makeTitleFill(parent, name)
		local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
		bar.Name = name
		bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.layProps(bar, function()
			local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
			return {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, -pad, 0, -pad),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, pad * 2, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar),
				BackgroundTransparency = C.MODE.Structure.TitleBarFill and 0 or 1,
			}
		end)
		bar.Parent = parent
		table.insert(W.getThemed().surfaces, { inst = bar, surface = "titleBar" })
		W.paint(bar, "BackgroundColor3", "Header")
		W.addCorner(bar, "Big")
		local squareBottom = Instance.new("Frame")
		squareBottom.Name = "SquareBottom"
		squareBottom.BorderSizePixel = 0
		squareBottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		squareBottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		W.paint(squareBottom, "BackgroundColor3", "Header")
		W.lay(squareBottom, "Visible", function()
			return C.MODE.Structure.TitleBarFill == true
		end)
		squareBottom.Parent = bar

		local rule = Instance.new("Frame")
		rule.Name = "Rule"
		rule.BorderSizePixel = 0
		rule.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
		rule.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		W.paint(rule, "BackgroundColor3", "PanelStroke")
		rule.Parent = bar
		return bar
	end

	function W.makeTitleBar(panel, titleText, order)
		local item = Instance.new("Frame")
		item.Name = "TitleBar"
		item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		-- The bar starts a panel padding above this item, so the next row lands a panel padding below it.
		W.lay(item, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar - LAYOUT.RowGap)
		end)
		item.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		item.Parent = panel
		W.makeTitleFill(item, "Bar")
		local header = W.makeTitleHeader(item)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = titleText
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		W.lay(title, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		end)
		TypeScale.style(title, "Title")
		W.paint(title, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
		title.Parent = header

		local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
		close.Name = "Close"
		close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		close.Text = "\u{00D7}"
		W.layProps(close, function()
			return { Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0) }
		end)
		close.ZIndex = 3
		TypeScale.style(close, "Glyph")
		W.paint(close, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		close.Parent = header

		local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
		dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		dragHandle.Text = ""
		W.lay(dragHandle, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		end)
		dragHandle.ZIndex = 2
		dragHandle.Parent = header

		return { header = header, title = title, close = close, dragHandle = dragHandle }
	end

	function W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = labelText
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		W.lay(label, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(0, W.measure(labelWidth), 1, 0)
		end)
		TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
		W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		label.Parent = row
		return label
	end

	function W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = name
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		W.lay(row, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		end)
		row.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		row.Parent = parent
		return row
	end

	function W.makeTextField(parent, name, text, alignment)
		local field = W.makeBlob(name .. "InputWrap", parent)
		W.lay(field, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		end)

		local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
		box.Name = name .. "Box"
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.Text = text
		box.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
		box.TextXAlignment = alignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.layProps(box, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, 0) }
		end)
		TypeScale.style(box, "Number")
		box.Parent = field
		W.wireFieldStates(field, box)
		return box, field
	end

	function W.makeSearchField(parent, name, placeholder)
		local box, field = W.makeTextField(parent, name, "")
		W.lay(field, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Search)
		end)
		box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
		TypeScale.style(box, "Value")
		return box, field
	end

	function W.makeNumberRow(parent, name, labelText, defaultText, labelWidth, order)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, labelWidth)

		local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, name, defaultText, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		W.layProps(field, function()
			local offset = W.measure(labelWidth) + LAYOUT.LabelGap
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, offset, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -offset, 1, 0) }
		end)
		return box, row
	end

	-- Returns the toggle, the row and the label.
	function W.makeSwitchRow(parent, name, labelText, order)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name .. "Row", order)
		local label = W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, 0)
		W.lay(label, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.ToggleWidth + LAYOUT.LabelGap), 1, 0)
		end)

		local toggle = W.makeToggle(name, row, true)
		toggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
		return toggle, row, label
	end

	function W.makeLoadingList(parent, name)
		local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		list.Name = name
		list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		list.BorderSizePixel = 0
		list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		list.ScrollBarThickness = 4
		list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
		list.Parent = parent
		W.addListLayout(list, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)

		local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
		placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
		placeholder.TextWrapped = true
		W.lay(placeholder, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		end)
		TypeScale.style(placeholder, "Caption")
		W.paint(placeholder, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		placeholder.Parent = list
		return list
	end

	-- Hidden until its opener shows it.
	function W.makeMenu(parent, name, width)
		local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
		menu.Name = name
		menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.lay(menu, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(0, W.measure(width), 0, 0)
		end)
		menu.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		menu.Visible = false
		W.paint(menu, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
		menu.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(menu)
		W.addStroke(menu)
		W.addPadding(menu, 4, 4, 4, 4)
		W.addListLayout(menu, 2)
		return menu
	end

	-- Lit under the cursor; its text colour is the caller's (a menu greys out what cannot be used).
	function W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, text, order)
		local item = Instance.new("TextButton")
		item.Name = name
		item.Text = text
		item.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		item.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		item.AutoButtonColor = false
		item.BorderSizePixel = 0
		item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		W.lay(item, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row - 4)
		end)
		item.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		TypeScale.style(item, "Label")
		item.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		W.paint(item, "BackgroundColor3", "FieldHover")
		item.Parent = menu
		W.addCorner(item)
		W.addPadding(item, 8, 8, 0, 0)
		item.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if W.pointerBlocked(item) then return end
			item.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		end)
		item.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end)
		return item
	end

	-- air (a function, laid with the layout) sets the room on each side.
	function W.makeDivider(parent, order, air)
		local divider = Instance.new("Frame")
		divider.Name = "Divider"
		divider.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 5)
		if air then
			W.lay(divider, "Size", function()
				return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, air() * 2 + 1)
			end)
		end
		divider.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		divider.Parent = parent

		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Line"
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		W.paint(line, "BackgroundColor3", "Divider")
		line.Parent = divider
		return divider
	end

	function W.makeGroupBreak(parent, order)
		local divider = W.makeDivider(parent, order, function()
			return math.max(LAYOUT.PanelPad - LAYOUT.RowGap, 0)
		end)
		divider.Name = "Break"
		return divider
	end

	-- textRole (default TextPrimary) colours its text.
	function W.makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = name
		button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.AutoButtonColor = true
		button.Text = text
		W.lay(button, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		end)
		button.LayoutOrder = order or 0
		TypeScale.style(button, "Button")
		W.paint(button, "TextColor3", textRole or "TextPrimary")
		button.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(button)
		W.addStroke(button)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, button)
		W.wireFieldStates(button)
		return button
	end

	function W.makeTextButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		local button = W.makeActionButton(parent, name, text, order, textRole)
		button.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		W.addPadding(button, 10, 10, 0, 0)
		return button
	end

	-- specs = { { name, text, role? }, ... }; returns the buttons in that order, then the row.
	function W.makeButtonRow(parent, name, specs, order)
		local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, name, order)
		W.addListLayout(row, "RowGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

		local count = #specs
		local buttons = {}
		for index, spec in ipairs(specs) do
			local button = W.makeActionButton(row, spec.name, spec.text, index, spec.role)
			W.lay(button, "Size", function()
				return UDim2.new(1 / count, -LAYOUT.RowGap * (count - 1) / count, 1, 0)
			end)
			buttons[index] = button
		end
		return buttons, row
	end
end

--[[
	PanelPush  -  a panel whose content scrolls (Properties, the Inventory) gives way to a panel opened
	or moved over it: the covered edge slides back until they no longer overlap or the panel is at its
	minimum, and slides out again once the other moves off or closes. Tool panels lay controls at fixed
	places, so they are never pushed. Loaded by Widgets.luau after PanelStack; adds to W:
	  allowPush(panel, minWidth, minHeight)  from a panel's builder: it may give way, down to its resize floor
	  watchPanelPush(screenGui)              starts it for that ScreenGui's panels once built and placed
	  requestPanelPush()                     PanelStack calls it whenever the layers change
	  panelArrived(panel)                    makeDraggable / makeResizable call it on a move or resize by hand
	  panelPushed(panel) -> boolean          true while a push holds the panel smaller
	  restingPosition(panel) / restingSize(panel) -> UDim2   the panel's own place and size
	  releasePushes()                        every panel back to its own place at once
	A panel yields to those that arrived (opened, dragged or resized by hand) after it; a press changes
	its layer but not this order. Rules.giveWay picks the edge. Runs when a stacked panel moves,
	resizes, shows or hides.
	Mutates the LIVE panels' Position and Size while a push lasts; nothing is saved. A write from other
	code to a pushed panel is taken over next frame: a new Position moves its own place by the same
	step, a new Size becomes its own size on that axis.
	Cross-file:
	  - Code that keeps a panel's place or size reads restingPosition / restingSize, never Position /
	    Size: PanelPersistence, WidgetSections.makeCollapse, PropertiesTabs.
	  - Code that sets a Position outright calls releasePushes() first: Reset Layout (UIBuilder),
	    PanelPersistence (restored positions).
	  - PropertiesTabs leaves its panel's height alone while panelPushed(panel).
	  - Workspaces tells a parked panel by its Position: a panel with _workspaceParked is skipped here.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Rules = require(script.Rules)

-- Space kept between a pushed edge and the panel in front, before the UI scale.
local GAP = 6
-- Height a push always leaves, before the UI scale: title, search bar and a few rows.
local FLOOR_HEIGHT = 160
-- Exponential approach: each frame covers 1 - exp(-FOLLOW_RATE * dt) of the travel left.
local FOLLOW_RATE = 18
local SETTLE_PIXELS = 0.5
local PARKED_ATTRIBUTE = "_workspaceParked"
local EDGES = { "Left", "Top", "Right", "Bottom" }
-- Position and Size too: a disabled ScreenGui lays out only when read and signals no absolute change.
local WATCHED = { "Position", "Size", "AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize" }

return function(W)
	local gui = nil
	-- panel -> { minWidth, minHeight, held, inset, goal, restPosition, restSize, writtenPosition,
	-- writtenSize }; inset and goal per edge in screen pixels; rest and written only while held.
	local pushable = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	-- Tracked panels, the one that arrived last at the end.
	local arrivals = {}
	local dirty = false
	local moving = false
	local frameConnection = nil

	function W.requestPanelPush()
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Popups and dialogs are draggable too but never tracked: they push nothing.
	function W.panelArrived(panel)
		if not tracked[panel] or arrivals[#arrivals] == panel then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(arrivals, panel)
		if index then
			table.remove(arrivals, index)
		end
		table.insert(arrivals, panel)
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Screen pixels per Position and per Size offset: a panel's own UIScale scales Size, not Position.
	local function scalesOf(panel)
		local guiScale = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local screenScale = 1
		if guiScale and guiScale.Scale > 0 then
			screenScale = guiScale.Scale
		end
		local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local sizeScale = screenScale
		if ownScale and ownScale.Scale > 0 then
			sizeScale = screenScale * ownScale.Scale
		end
		return screenScale, sizeScale
	end

	-- Takes over what other code wrote to a pushed panel since this module's last write.
	local function absorb(panel, state)
		local position = panel.Position
		local size = panel.Size
		if position ~= state.writtenPosition then
			state.restPosition += position - state.writtenPosition
			state.writtenPosition = position
		end
		if size ~= state.writtenSize then
			local restX = state.restSize.X
			local restY = state.restSize.Y
			if size.X ~= state.writtenSize.X then
				restX = size.X
				state.inset.Left = 0
				state.inset.Right = 0
			end
			if size.Y ~= state.writtenSize.Y then
				restY = size.Y
				state.inset.Top = 0
				state.inset.Bottom = 0
			end
			state.restSize = UDim2.new(restX, restY)
			state.writtenSize = size
		end
	end

	-- The panel's own place less its insets, both rounded alike so the unpushed edge stays still.
	local function write(panel, state)
		local inset = state.inset
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local anchor = panel.AnchorPoint
		local restPosition = state.restPosition
		local restSize = state.restSize
		local shiftX = (inset.Left * (1 - anchor.X) - inset.Right * anchor.X) / screenScale
		local shiftY = (inset.Top * (1 - anchor.Y) - inset.Bottom * anchor.Y) / screenScale
		local lostWidth = (inset.Left + inset.Right) / sizeScale
		local lostHeight = (inset.Top + inset.Bottom) / sizeScale
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			restPosition.X.Scale, math.round(restPosition.X.Offset + shiftX),
			restPosition.Y.Scale, math.round(restPosition.Y.Offset + shiftY)
		)
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(
			restSize.X.Scale, math.round(restSize.X.Offset - lostWidth),
			restSize.Y.Scale, math.round(restSize.Y.Offset - lostHeight)
		)
		state.writtenPosition = panel.Position
		state.writtenSize = panel.Size
	end

	local function hold(panel, state)
		state.held = true
		state.restPosition = panel.Position
		state.restSize = panel.Size
		state.writtenPosition = panel.Position
		state.writtenSize = panel.Size
	end

	-- Puts a pushed panel back at its own place without the slide.
	local function release(panel, state)
		absorb(panel, state)
		for _, edge in ipairs(EDGES) do
			state.inset[edge] = 0
			state.goal[edge] = 0
		end
		write(panel, state)
		state.held = false
	end

	-- The panel's box at its own place (its box less the push); exact only right after absorb.
	local function restRect(panel, state)
		local origin = panel.AbsolutePosition
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize
		local rect = { Left = origin.X, Top = origin.Y, Right = origin.X + size.X, Bottom = origin.Y + size.Y }
		if not (state and state.held) then
			return rect
		end
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local anchor = panel.AnchorPoint
		local width = size.X + (state.restSize.X.Offset - state.writtenSize.X.Offset) * sizeScale
		local height = size.Y + (state.restSize.Y.Offset - state.writtenSize.Y.Offset) * sizeScale
		local pointX = origin.X + anchor.X * size.X
			+ (state.restPosition.X.Offset - state.writtenPosition.X.Offset) * screenScale
		local pointY = origin.Y + anchor.Y * size.Y
			+ (state.restPosition.Y.Offset - state.writtenPosition.Y.Offset) * screenScale
		rect.Left = pointX - anchor.X * width
		rect.Right = rect.Left + width
		rect.Top = pointY - anchor.Y * height
		rect.Bottom = rect.Top + height
		return rect
	end

	-- Sets a panel's goal from the boxes in front and shrinks `rect` to the box it will end up with.
	local function aim(panel, state, rect, front)
		local screenScale, sizeScale = scalesOf(panel)
		local restLeft = rect.Left
		local restTop = rect.Top
		local restRight = rect.Right
		local restBottom = rect.Bottom
		-- A panel already under its minimum (collapsed to its title) does not shrink on that axis.
		local floorWidth = math.min(state.minWidth * sizeScale, restRight - restLeft)
		local floorHeight = math.min(math.max(state.minHeight, FLOOR_HEIGHT) * sizeScale, restBottom - restTop)
		for _, other in ipairs(front) do
			if Rules.overlaps(rect, other) then
				Rules.giveWay(rect, other, floorWidth, floorHeight, GAP * screenScale)
			end
		end

		local goal = state.goal
		goal.Left = rect.Left - restLeft
		goal.Top = rect.Top - restTop
		goal.Right = restRight - rect.Right
		goal.Bottom = restBottom - rect.Bottom
		local pushed = goal.Left > 0 or goal.Top > 0 or goal.Right > 0 or goal.Bottom > 0
		if pushed and not state.held then
			hold(panel, state)
		end
	end

	local function track(panel)
		if tracked[panel] then
			return
		end
		tracked[panel] = true
		table.insert(arrivals, panel)
		local connections = W.getUISConnections()
		for _, property in ipairs(WATCHED) do
			table.insert(connections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(W.requestPanelPush))
		end
		table.insert(connections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if panel.Visible then
				W.panelArrived(panel)
			end
			dirty = true
		end))
		table.insert(connections, panel:GetAttributeChangedSignal(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE):Connect(W.requestPanelPush))
	end

	-- Every goal, from the last arrival back: each panel yields to the boxes of later arrivals.
	local function solve()
		-- A panel PanelStack has taken in since the last pass joins in its layer order.
		for _, panel in ipairs(W.getPanelOrder()) do
			track(panel)
		end
		local front = {}
		for index = #arrivals, 1, -1 do
			local panel = arrivals[index]
			local state = pushable[panel]
			if panel.Parent ~= gui then
				table.remove(arrivals, index)
				continue
			end
			if panel:GetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE) then
				continue
			end
			if not panel.Visible then
				if state and state.held then
					release(panel, state)
				end
				continue
			end
			if state and state.held then
				absorb(panel, state)
			end
			local rect = restRect(panel, state)
			if state then
				aim(panel, state, rect, front)
			end
			table.insert(front, rect)
		end
	end

	-- Moves every pushed panel one frame toward its goal. Returns whether any is still travelling.
	local function advance(deltaTime)
		local share = 1 - math.exp(-FOLLOW_RATE * deltaTime)
		local travelling = false
		for panel, state in pairs(pushable) do
			if not state.held or panel.Parent ~= gui or panel:GetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE) then
				continue
			end
			absorb(panel, state)
			local atRest = true
			for _, edge in ipairs(EDGES) do
				local remaining = state.goal[edge] - state.inset[edge]
				if math.abs(remaining) <= SETTLE_PIXELS then
					state.inset[edge] = state.goal[edge]
				else
					state.inset[edge] += remaining * share
					travelling = true
				end
				if state.inset[edge] ~= 0 then
					atRest = false
				end
			end
			write(panel, state)
			if atRest then
				state.held = false
			end
		end
		return travelling
	end

	local function onFrame(deltaTime)
		if not dirty and not moving then
			return
		end
		if gui == nil or gui.Parent == nil then
			return
		end
		if dirty then
			dirty = false
			solve()
		end
		moving = advance(deltaTime)
	end

	-- The panel must size itself by Size offsets alone, and its content scroll or reflow in what is left.
	function W.allowPush(panel, minWidth, minHeight)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state then
			state.minWidth = minWidth
			state.minHeight = minHeight
			return
		end
		pushable[panel] = {
			minWidth = minWidth,
			minHeight = minHeight,
			held = false,
			inset = { Left = 0, Top = 0, Right = 0, Bottom = 0 },
			goal = { Left = 0, Top = 0, Right = 0, Bottom = 0 },
		}
	end

	function W.panelPushed(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		return state ~= nil and state.held
	end

	function W.restingPosition(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state and state.held then
			absorb(panel, state)
			return state.restPosition
		end
		return panel.Position
	end

	function W.restingSize(panel)
		local state = pushable[panel]
		if state and state.held then
			absorb(panel, state)
			return state.restSize
		end
		return panel.Size
	end

	function W.releasePushes()
		for panel, state in pairs(pushable) do
			if state.held and panel.Parent == gui then
				release(panel, state)
			end
		end
		dirty = true
	end

	-- Panels of an earlier build stay registered until collected; no longer under `gui`, they are skipped.
	function W.watchPanelPush(screenGui)
		gui = screenGui
		tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		arrivals = {}
		dirty = true
		moving = false
		if frameConnection then
			frameConnection:Disconnect()
		end
		frameConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onFrame)
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), frameConnection)
	end
end

--[[
	PanelPush/Rules  -  the geometry of one panel giving way to another. Pure: no instances.
	A rect is { Left, Top, Right, Bottom } in screen pixels.
	  Rules.overlaps(rect, front) -> boolean
	  Rules.giveWay(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	      Moves one edge of `rect` inward, away from `front`. The edge is the one that clears
	      `front` (leaving `gap`) with the least travel while `rect` stays at least floorWidth by
	      floorHeight. When no edge can clear it, the edge with the least travel goes as far as
	      the floor allows.
]]

-- Rects that share less than this many pixels on an axis do not count as overlapping.
local TOUCH_TOLERANCE = 1

local Rules = {}

function Rules.overlaps(rect, front)
	local sharedWidth = math.min(rect.Right, front.Right) - math.max(rect.Left, front.Left)
	local sharedHeight = math.min(rect.Bottom, front.Bottom) - math.max(rect.Top, front.Top)
	return sharedWidth > TOUCH_TOLERANCE and sharedHeight > TOUCH_TOLERANCE
end

-- Inward travel that clears `front` for each edge, and how far the edge may travel at all.
local function options(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	local roomX = math.max(0, rect.Right - rect.Left - floorWidth)
	local roomY = math.max(0, rect.Bottom - rect.Top - floorHeight)
	return {
		{ edge = "Left", travel = front.Right + gap - rect.Left, room = roomX },
		{ edge = "Right", travel = rect.Right - (front.Left - gap), room = roomX },
		{ edge = "Top", travel = front.Bottom + gap - rect.Top, room = roomY },
		{ edge = "Bottom", travel = rect.Bottom - (front.Top - gap), room = roomY },
	}
end

function Rules.giveWay(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)
	local clearing = nil
	local nearest = nil
	for _, option in ipairs(options(rect, front, floorWidth, floorHeight, gap)) do
		if nearest == nil or option.travel < nearest.travel then
			nearest = option
		end
		if option.travel <= option.room and (clearing == nil or option.travel < clearing.travel) then
			clearing = option
		end
	end

	local chosen = clearing or nearest
	local travel = math.min(chosen.travel, chosen.room)
	if chosen.edge == "Left" then
		rect.Left += travel
	elseif chosen.edge == "Right" then
		rect.Right -= travel
	elseif chosen.edge == "Top" then
		rect.Top += travel
	else
		rect.Bottom -= travel
	end
end

return Rules

--[[
	PanelStack  -  keeps the floating panels in the order last used: the panel last pressed, dragged
	or opened draws over the others. Loaded by Widgets.luau; adds to W:
	  watchPanelStack(screenGui)         starts the ordering for a ScreenGui's top-level panels
	  raisePanel(panel)                  brings a stacked panel to the front
	  getPanelOrder()                    the stacked panels, least recently used first
	  linkPanelBackground(panel, image)  from Widgets.attachPanelBackground: the image stays one layer under
	Stacked: each direct GuiObject child of the ScreenGui, not a button, with a ZIndex from 1 to
	POPUP_FLOOR - 1 when added; its ZIndex is this module's from then on. Popups (menus, modals and
	their backdrops, toasts, option lists, the Config and Hit Filter panels) keep a ZIndex of
	POPUP_FLOOR or more and stay over every panel. Layers run down from POPUP_FLOOR - 2, two per
	showing panel: the panel, then its background image.
	Mutates the LIVE top-level panels' and background images' ZIndex; nothing is saved. Runs on a
	mouse press over a panel and on a panel becoming visible; tells PanelPush each time
	(W.requestPanelPush), which reads the list.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local POPUP_FLOOR = 20
local TOP_LAYER = POPUP_FLOOR - 2
local BACKGROUND_NAME = "PanelBackgroundImage"

return function(W)
	local gui = nil
	-- Stacked panels, least recently used first.
	local order = {}
	local stacked = {}
	local backgroundOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local isBackground = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	-- Hands out the layers, the most recently used showing panel on top; panels that left the
	-- ScreenGui are dropped.
	local function applyLayers()
		local layer = TOP_LAYER
		for index = #order, 1, -1 do
			local panel = order[index]
			if panel.Parent ~= gui then
				table.remove(order, index)
				stacked[panel] = nil
			elseif panel.Visible then
				panel.ZIndex = layer
				local background = backgroundOf[panel]
				if background then
					background.ZIndex = layer - 1
				end
				layer -= 2
			end
		end
		W.requestPanelPush()
	end

	-- The live list: PanelPush reads it and must not change it.
	function W.getPanelOrder()
		return order
	end

	function W.raisePanel(panel)
		if not stacked[panel] then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(order, panel)
		if index then
			table.remove(order, index)
		end
		table.insert(order, panel)
		applyLayers()
	end

	function W.linkPanelBackground(panel, image)
		backgroundOf[panel] = image
		isBackground[image] = true
		if stacked[panel] then
			image.ZIndex = panel.ZIndex - 1
		end
	end

	local function adopt(child)
		if stacked[child] or isBackground[child] or child.Parent ~= gui then
			return
		end
		if not child:IsA("GuiObject") or child:IsA("GuiButton") or child.Name == BACKGROUND_NAME then
			return
		end
		if child.ZIndex < 1 or child.ZIndex >= POPUP_FLOOR then
			return
		end
		stacked[child] = true
		table.insert(order, child)
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if child.Visible then
				W.raisePanel(child)
			end
		end))
		if child.Visible then
			applyLayers()
		end
	end

	local function contains(object, point)
		local origin = object.AbsolutePosition
		local size = object.AbsoluteSize
		return point.X >= origin.X and point.Y >= origin.Y and point.X <= origin.X + size.X and point.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
	end

	-- The top-level object drawn last at `point`: the highest ZIndex, the later sibling on a tie.
	-- A popup or a modal backdrop over a panel is found first, so a press on it raises nothing.
	local function topmostAt(point)
		local best = nil
		for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible and not isBackground[child] and contains(child, point) then
				if best == nil or child.ZIndex >= best.ZIndex then
					best = child
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	function W.watchPanelStack(screenGui)
		gui = screenGui
		order = {}
		stacked = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			adopt(child)
		end
		local connections = W.getUISConnections()
		table.insert(connections, gui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			-- Deferred: a builder sets ZIndex and Visible around the line that parents the frame.
			task.defer(adopt, child)
		end))
		table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local kind = input.UserInputType
			if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
				return
			end
			if not gui.Enabled then
				return
			end
			local top = topmostAt(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
			if top and stacked[top] then
				W.raisePanel(top)
			end
		end))
	end
end

--[[
	PropertiesShell  -  the Properties panel's frame around its list: padding, title bar, close
	button, search field and the scrolling list. Classic builds a boxed header; other modes a title
	bar that spans the panel.
	PropertiesShell.build(W, panel) -> { header, closeButton, searchWrap, searchBox, scroll, top,
	  collapsedHeight, arrowPosition, scrollbar }
	  header           where the tabs view and the collapse arrow add their controls
	  top              y of the search field, where the tabs view starts (a number or a function)
	  collapsedHeight  panel height collapsed to its title bar
	  scrollbar        { thickness, gap } of the list outside Classic (nil in Classic); the tabs view
	                   uses the same so both stand clear of the bar
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local PropertiesShell = {}

-- Outside the Classic mode: the scrollbar's thickness, and the gap between it and the rows.
local SCROLLBAR = 3
local SCROLLBAR_GAP = 4

-- inset: a number that stays, or a function that follows the layout.
local function makeSearchBox(W, searchWrap, inset)
	local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	searchBox.Name = "SearchBox"
	searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	searchBox.Text = ""
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search properties..."
	searchBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	W.layProps(searchBox, function()
		local pad = type(inset) == "function" and inset() or inset
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, 0) }
	end)
	searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	searchBox.Parent = searchWrap
	W.wireFieldStates(searchWrap, searchBox)
	return searchBox
end

local function makeScroll(W, panel, top, thickness, gap)
	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "Content"
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = thickness
	scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Parent = panel
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scroll)
	W.addListLayout(scroll, gap)
	return scroll
end

local function makeDragHandle(W, panel, header)
	local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	dragHandle.Name = "DragHandle"
	dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dragHandle.Text = ""
	dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
	dragHandle.ZIndex = 2
	dragHandle.Parent = header
	W.makeDraggable(panel, dragHandle)
end

-- Classic: a boxed header, a search box under it, then the list.
local function buildClassic(W, panel)
	W.addPadding(panel, 6, 6, 6, 6)
	local header = W.makeBlob("Header", panel, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26))

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Properties"
	title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	TypeScale.style(title, "Title")
	title.Parent = header

	local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeButton.Name = "Close"
	closeButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeButton.Text = "X"
	closeButton.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 0)
	closeButton.ZIndex = 3
	TypeScale.style(closeButton, "Title")
	closeButton.Parent = header
	makeDragHandle(W, panel, header)

	local searchWrap = W.makeBlob("SearchWrap", panel, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20))
	searchWrap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
	local searchBox = makeSearchBox(W, searchWrap, 4)
	TypeScale.style(searchBox, "Caption")

	return {
		header = header,
		closeButton = closeButton,
		searchWrap = searchWrap,
		searchBox = searchBox,
		scroll = makeScroll(W, panel, 52, 3, 4),
		top = 28,
		collapsedHeight = 38,
		arrowPosition = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 0),
	}
end

local function buildModern(W, panel)
	W.addPadding(panel, "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad", "PanelPad")
	-- Spans the panel edge to edge, above the padded content.
	W.makeTitleFill(panel, "TitleBar")

	-- Header content sits inside the panel padding, so controls keep their offsets from its edges.
	local header = W.makeTitleHeader(panel)

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Properties"
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(title, "Title")
	W.paint(title, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	title.Parent = header

	local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeButton.Name = "Close"
	closeButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeButton.Text = "\u{00D7}"
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
	closeButton.ZIndex = 3
	TypeScale.style(closeButton, "Glyph")
	W.paint(closeButton, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	closeButton.Parent = header
	makeDragHandle(W, panel, header)

	-- Search, then the list: each starts one panel padding below the element above it.
	local function listTop()
		return LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.Search + LAYOUT.PanelPad
	end
	local searchWrap = W.makeBlob("SearchWrap", panel)
	W.layProps(searchWrap, function()
		return { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Search), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar) }
	end)
	local searchBox = makeSearchBox(W, searchWrap, function()
		return LAYOUT.FieldPad
	end)
	TypeScale.style(searchBox, "Value")

	local scroll = makeScroll(W, panel, 0, SCROLLBAR, "TypeGap")
	-- The list reaches into the panel's right padding by the gap and the bar, and always keeps the
	-- bar's strip: rows stay as wide as the search field and a field's outline is inside the clip.
	W.layProps(scroll, function()
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listTop()), Size = UDim2.new(1, SCROLLBAR_GAP + SCROLLBAR, 1, -listTop()) }
	end)
	scroll.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
	W.addPadding(scroll, 0, SCROLLBAR_GAP, 0, 0)

	return {
		header = header,
		closeButton = closeButton,
		searchWrap = searchWrap,
		searchBox = searchBox,
		scroll = scroll,
		top = function()
			return LAYOUT.TitleBar
		end,
		collapsedHeight = function()
			return LAYOUT.TitleBar
		end,
		arrowPosition = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0),
		scrollbar = { thickness = SCROLLBAR, gap = SCROLLBAR_GAP },
	}
end

function PropertiesShell.build(W, panel)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(W, panel)
	end
	return buildModern(W, panel)
end

return PropertiesShell
